package com.scout.control;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.Manifest;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.location.LocationManager;
import android.os.Build;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.res.Configuration;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.SystemClock;
import android.provider.Settings;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.WindowInsets;
import android.view.WindowManager;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.SeekBar;
import android.widget.ScrollView;
import android.widget.HorizontalScrollView;
import android.widget.Switch;
import android.widget.TextView;

public final class MainActivity extends Activity implements ScoutClient.Listener {
    private static final int BG = 0xff0c1713, CARD = 0xff17291f, TEXT = 0xffedf6ef;
    private static final int MUTED = 0xff91ab9c, MINT = 0xffa3e9c0, STOP = 0xffedb296;
    private ScoutClient client;
    private JoystickView joystick;
    private TextView statusTitle, statusDetail, leftPower, rightPower, speedValue;
    private Button connect, calibration;
    private final Button[] faceButtons = new Button[11];
    private TextView faceStatus;
    private LinearLayout root;
    private boolean resumed;
    private boolean permissionForCalibration;
    private final Handler main = new Handler();
    private final Runnable heartbeat = new Runnable() {
        @Override public void run() {
            if (resumed && hasWindowFocus()) client.state.heartbeat(SystemClock.elapsedRealtime());
            changed(); main.postDelayed(this, 50);
        }
    };
    @Override public void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        getWindow().getDecorView().setSystemUiVisibility(View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE | View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN | View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION);
        getWindow().addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON);
        client = new ScoutClient(getApplicationContext(), this); build(); main.post(heartbeat);
    }
    private int dp(float v) { return Math.round(v * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density); }
    private GradientDrawable shape(int color, int stroke, int radius) {
        GradientDrawable d = new GradientDrawable(); d.setColor(color); d.setCornerRadius(dp(radius));
        if (stroke != 0) d.setStroke(dp(1), stroke); return d;
    }
    private TextView text(String value, float size, int color, boolean bold) {
        TextView t = new TextView(this); t.setText(value); t.setTextSize(size); t.setTextColor(color);
        t.setIncludeFontPadding(false); if (bold) t.setTypeface(Typeface.create("sans-serif-medium", Typeface.NORMAL)); return t;
    }
    private LinearLayout column() { LinearLayout v = new LinearLayout(this); v.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL); return v; }
    private LinearLayout row() { LinearLayout v = new LinearLayout(this); v.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL); v.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL); return v; }
    private LinearLayout.LayoutParams size(int w, int h) { return new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(w < 0 ? w : dp(w), h < 0 ? h : dp(h)); }
    private void gap(LinearLayout v, int h) { v.addView(new View(this), size(1,h)); }
    private Button button(String value, int color, int foreground) {
        Button b = new Button(this); b.setText(value); b.setAllCaps(false); b.setTextSize(14); b.setTypeface(Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD);
        b.setTextColor(foreground); b.setBackground(shape(color, 0, 14)); b.setMinHeight(0); b.setMinimumHeight(0);
        b.setPadding(dp(12), 0, dp(12), 0); b.setStateListAnimator(null); return b;
    }
    private void build() {
        boolean wide = getResources().getConfiguration().orientation == Configuration.ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE;
        root = column(); root.setBackgroundColor(BG); root.setPadding(dp(18), dp(12), dp(18), dp(12));
        root.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener((view, insets) -> {
            int l, t, r, b;
            if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 30) {
                android.graphics.Insets safe = insets.getInsets(WindowInsets.Type.systemBars() | WindowInsets.Type.displayCutout());
                l=safe.left; t=safe.top; r=safe.right; b=safe.bottom;
            } else { l=insets.getSystemWindowInsetLeft(); t=insets.getSystemWindowInsetTop(); r=insets.getSystemWindowInsetRight(); b=insets.getSystemWindowInsetBottom(); }
            root.setPadding(dp(18)+l, dp(wide ? 8 : 12)+t, dp(18)+r, dp(10)+b); return insets;
        });
        setContentView(root); root.requestApplyInsets();
        LinearLayout header = row();
        LinearLayout branding = column();
        TextView brand = text("SCOUT", 25, TEXT, true); brand.setLetterSpacing(.16f); branding.addView(brand);
        TextView sub = text("A LITTLE EXPLORER. IN YOUR HANDS.", 9, MUTED, true); sub.setLetterSpacing(.10f);
        branding.addView(sub, size(-2, -2)); header.addView(branding, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, -2, 1));
        TextView badge = text("LOCAL\nCONTROL", 9, MINT, true); badge.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER); badge.setLetterSpacing(.08f);
        badge.setBackground(shape(CARD, 0xff34523f, 10)); badge.setPadding(dp(12), dp(7), dp(12), dp(7));
        header.addView(badge); root.addView(header, size(-1, wide ? 48 : 58));
        LinearLayout content = wide ? row() : column();
        root.addView(content, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, 0, 1));
        LinearLayout controls = column();
        if (wide) {
            LinearLayout pad = column(); joystick = new JoystickView(this, client::input);
            pad.addView(joystick, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, 0, 1));
            TextView hint = text("DRAG TO EXPLORE  ·  RELEASE TO STOP", 9, MUTED, true); hint.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            pad.addView(hint, size(-1, 20)); content.addView(pad, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, -1, 1.1f));
            View spacer = new View(this); content.addView(spacer, size(18, 1));
            content.addView(controls, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, -1, 1));
            ScrollView scroller = new ScrollView(this); scroller.setFillViewport(false); scroller.setVerticalScrollBarEnabled(false);
            LinearLayout upper = column(); scroller.addView(upper); controls.addView(scroller, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1,0,1));
            connectionCard(upper, true); gap(upper, 8); speedControl(upper, true); gap(upper, 6); powerControl(upper, true);
            gap(upper, 8); faceControls(upper);
            gap(controls, 6); stopButton(controls, 48); footer(controls, true);
        } else {
            connectionCard(content, false);
            joystick = new JoystickView(this, client::input);
            content.addView(joystick, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, 0, 1));
            TextView hint = text("DRAG TO EXPLORE  ·  RELEASE TO STOP", 10, MUTED, true); hint.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER); hint.setLetterSpacing(.06f);
            content.addView(hint, size(-1, 24));
            speedControl(content, false); gap(content, 8); powerControl(content, false); gap(content, 8); faceControls(content); gap(content, 8); stopButton(content, 58); footer(content, false);
        }
        changed();
    }
    private void connectionCard(LinearLayout parent, boolean compact) {
        LinearLayout card = column(); card.setBackground(shape(CARD, 0xff2b4335, 16)); card.setPadding(dp(13), dp(10), dp(13), dp(10));
        LinearLayout top = row();
        statusTitle = text("○  Disconnected", compact ? 13 : 15, TEXT, true);
        top.addView(statusTitle, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, -2, 1));
        connect = button("Connect", MINT, 0xff143522); connect.setOnClickListener(v -> beginConnection(false)); top.addView(connect, size(88, compact ? 34 : 38));
        card.addView(top, size(-1,-2));
        statusDetail = text("Join C3-Scout-Test to get started", 11, MUTED, false); statusDetail.setMaxLines(3);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams detail = size(-1,-2); detail.topMargin=dp(5); card.addView(statusDetail, detail);
        parent.addView(card, size(-1,-2));
    }
    private void speedControl(LinearLayout parent, boolean compact) {
        LinearLayout title = row(); TextView label = text("DRIVE LIMIT", 10, MUTED, true); label.setLetterSpacing(.12f);
        title.addView(label, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,-2,1));
        speedValue = text("35%", compact ? 18 : 22, MINT, true); title.addView(speedValue); parent.addView(title, size(-1, compact ? 24 : 28));
        SeekBar seek = new SeekBar(this); seek.setMax(100); seek.setProgress(client.state.cap);
        seek.setContentDescription("Speed limit, percent"); seek.setProgressTintList(android.content.res.ColorStateList.valueOf(MINT));
        seek.setThumbTintList(android.content.res.ColorStateList.valueOf(MINT)); seek.setPadding(dp(8),0,dp(8),0);
        seek.setOnSeekBarChangeListener(new SeekBar.OnSeekBarChangeListener() {
            public void onProgressChanged(SeekBar bar, int value, boolean user) { if (user) client.speed(value); }
            public void onStartTrackingTouch(SeekBar bar) { }
            public void onStopTrackingTouch(SeekBar bar) { }
        }); parent.addView(seek, size(-1, compact ? 30 : 38));
        parent.addView(text("0–30% off  ·  motor power 40–100%", 10, MUTED, false), size(-1,18));
    }
    private void powerControl(LinearLayout parent, boolean compact) {
        LinearLayout powers = row(); powers.setBackground(shape(CARD, 0, 13)); powers.setPadding(dp(14),dp(7),dp(14),dp(7));
        leftPower = text("L  0%", compact ? 17 : 20, TEXT, true); rightPower = text("R  0%", compact ? 17 : 20, TEXT, true); rightPower.setGravity(Gravity.RIGHT);
        leftPower.setContentDescription("Left commanded motor power zero percent");
        powers.addView(leftPower, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,-2,1)); powers.addView(text("MOTOR TARGET", 8, MUTED, true));
        powers.addView(rightPower, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,-2,1)); parent.addView(powers, size(-1, compact ? 42 : 50));
    }
    private void stopButton(LinearLayout parent, int height) {
        Button stop = button("■   STOP", STOP, 0xff40271c); stop.setTextSize(19); stop.setLetterSpacing(.10f);
        stop.setContentDescription("Stop both motors and disconnect"); stop.setOnClickListener(v -> { joystick.reset(); client.stop("Stopped · reconnect to drive"); });
        parent.addView(stop, size(-1,height));
    }
    private void faceControls(LinearLayout parent) {
        LinearLayout heading = row();
        TextView title = text("SCOUT FACE", 10, MUTED, true);
        heading.addView(title, size(84, 22));
        faceStatus = text("Connect to choose a face", 10, MUTED, false);
        faceStatus.setSingleLine(true);
        faceStatus.setEllipsize(android.text.TextUtils.TruncateAt.END);
        heading.addView(faceStatus, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, dp(22), 1));
        parent.addView(heading, size(-1, 22));
        HorizontalScrollView scroller = new HorizontalScrollView(this);
        scroller.setHorizontalScrollBarEnabled(true);
        scroller.setContentDescription("Choose Scout face; swipe for more expressions");
        LinearLayout choices = row();
        for (int index = 0; index < faceButtons.length; ++index) {
            final int id = index - 1;
            Button choice = button(id == -1 ? "Auto" : FaceSelection.NAMES[id], CARD, TEXT);
            choice.setTextSize(12);
            choice.setContentDescription(id == -1 ? "Automatically cycle all faces" : "Choose " + FaceSelection.NAMES[id] + " face");
            choice.setOnClickListener(v -> client.selectFace(id));
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams params = size(-2, 44);
            params.rightMargin = dp(6);
            choices.addView(choice, params); faceButtons[index] = choice;
        }
        scroller.addView(choices);
        parent.addView(scroller, size(-1, 48));
    }
    private void footer(LinearLayout parent, boolean compact) {
        LinearLayout footer = row();
        Button wifi = button("Wi-Fi settings ↗", BG, MUTED); wifi.setTextSize(11); wifi.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            joystick.reset(); client.stop("Wi-Fi settings · reconnect to drive"); startActivity(new Intent(Settings.ACTION_WIFI_SETTINGS));
        });
        calibration = button("Motor directions", BG, MUTED); calibration.setTextSize(11); calibration.setOnClickListener(v -> beginConnection(true));
        footer.addView(wifi, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,-1,1)); footer.addView(calibration, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,-1,1));
        parent.addView(footer, size(-1,compact ? 36 : 42));
    }
    @Override public void changed() {
        if (joystick == null || client == null) return;
        synchronized (client.state) {
            SessionState s = client.state; boolean active = s.active(); joystick.ready(active);
            statusTitle.setText(active ? "●  Connected" : s.mode == SessionState.WAITING_WIFI ? "◌  Joining Scout…" : s.mode == SessionState.CONNECTING ? "◌  Connecting…" : s.mode == SessionState.ERROR ? "○  Connection ended" : "○  Disconnected");
            statusTitle.setTextColor(active ? MINT : s.mode == SessionState.ERROR ? STOP : TEXT);
            statusDetail.setText(s.message); speedValue.setText(s.cap + "%");
            leftPower.setText("L  " + signed(s.left)); rightPower.setText("R  " + signed(s.right));
            leftPower.setContentDescription("Left commanded motor power " + s.left + " percent");
            rightPower.setContentDescription("Right commanded motor power " + s.right + " percent");
            connect.setEnabled(!active && s.mode != SessionState.CONNECTING && s.mode != SessionState.WAITING_WIFI && !client.busy()); connect.setAlpha(connect.isEnabled() ? 1f : .45f);
            calibration.setEnabled(!active && s.mode != SessionState.CONNECTING && s.mode != SessionState.WAITING_WIFI && !client.busy()); calibration.setAlpha(calibration.isEnabled() ? 1f : .35f);
            if (faceStatus != null) {
                FaceSelection f = client.faces;
                faceStatus.setText(active ? f.message : "Connect to choose a face");
                for (int i = 0; i < faceButtons.length; ++i) {
                    Button b = faceButtons[i]; if (b == null) continue;
                    boolean enabled = active && f.supported && f.available;
                    b.setEnabled(enabled); b.setAlpha(enabled ? 1f : .35f);
                    boolean selected = active && i - 1 == f.selected;
                    if (b.isSelected() != selected) {
                        b.setSelected(selected);
                        b.setBackground(shape(selected ? MINT : CARD, 0, 14));
                        b.setTextColor(selected ? 0xff143522 : TEXT);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    private String signed(int power) { return (power > 0 ? "+" : "") + power + "%"; }
    private void beginConnection(boolean calibrate) {
        permissionForCalibration = calibrate;
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29) {
            String permission = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33 ? Manifest.permission.NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES : Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION;
            if (checkSelfPermission(permission) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                String[] requested = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33 ? new String[] {permission} : new String[] {Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, permission};
                requestPermissions(requested, 41); return;
            }
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < 33 && !((LocationManager) getSystemService(LOCATION_SERVICE)).isLocationEnabled()) {
                new AlertDialog.Builder(this).setTitle("Enable Wi-Fi device connections")
                    .setMessage("This Android version requires Location to be on to connect directly to Scout. Scout does not read your GPS location.")
                    .setPositiveButton("Open settings", (d,w) -> startActivity(new Intent(Settings.ACTION_LOCATION_SOURCE_SETTINGS)))
                    .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null).show(); return;
            }
        }
        if (calibrate) client.inspectCalibration(); else client.connect();
    }
    @Override public void onRequestPermissionsResult(int requestCode, String[] permissions, int[] results) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, results);
        if (requestCode == 41) {
            String permission = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33 ? Manifest.permission.NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES : Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION;
            if (checkSelfPermission(permission) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) beginConnection(permissionForCalibration);
            else client.stop("Wi-Fi permission is needed to connect to Scout");
        }
    }
    private boolean waitingForWifi() { synchronized (client.state) { return client.state.mode == SessionState.WAITING_WIFI; } }
    @Override public void calibration(boolean left, boolean right) {
        LinearLayout body = column(); body.setPadding(dp(22),dp(8),dp(22),dp(8));
        TextView info = text("Flip a motor's direction if forward turns that wheel backward. Scout stays stopped while directions are saved.", 14, MUTED, false);
        body.addView(info); gap(body,16);
        Switch l = new Switch(this); l.setText("Reverse left motor"); l.setTextColor(TEXT); l.setChecked(left); body.addView(l,size(-1,48));
        Switch r = new Switch(this); r.setText("Reverse right motor"); r.setTextColor(TEXT); r.setChecked(right); body.addView(r,size(-1,48));
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this).setTitle("Motor directions").setView(body).setNegativeButton("Cancel",null)
            .setPositiveButton("Save directions",(dialog, which) -> client.configure(l.isChecked(), r.isChecked())).show();
    }
    @Override protected void onResume() { super.onResume(); resumed = true; }
    @Override protected void onPause() {
        resumed = false; if (client != null && !waitingForWifi()) client.leave("App paused · reconnect to drive"); if (joystick != null) joystick.reset(); super.onPause();
    }
    @Override public void onWindowFocusChanged(boolean focus) {
        super.onWindowFocusChanged(focus);
        if (!focus && client != null) {
            synchronized (client.state) {
                if (client.state.mode == SessionState.ACTIVE || client.state.mode == SessionState.CONNECTING)
                    client.stop("Focus lost · reconnect to drive");
            }
            if (joystick != null) joystick.reset();
        }
    }
    @Override protected void onStop() { if (client != null) client.leave("App hidden · reconnect to drive"); super.onStop(); }
    @Override public void onConfigurationChanged(Configuration configuration) {
        super.onConfigurationChanged(configuration); client.stop("Layout changed · reconnect to drive"); build();
    }
    @Override protected void onDestroy() {
        main.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null); if (client != null) client.close(); super.onDestroy();
    }
}

package com.scout.control;

public final class Mixer {
    private Mixer() { }
    public static int[] mix(float forward, float turn, int cap) {
        if (!Float.isFinite(forward) || !Float.isFinite(turn)) return new int[] {0, 0};
        float radius = (float) Math.hypot(forward, turn);
        if (radius <= .08f) return new int[] {0, 0};
        float gain = (Math.min(1, radius) - .08f) / .92f / radius;
        // Scout's motor polarity is calibrated on the ESP; steering uses the
        // opposite differential so left/right match the assembled rover.
        // Reverse steering with travel direction; keep stationary turns unchanged.
        float steering = forward < 0 ? -turn : turn;
        float left = (forward - steering) * gain;
        float right = (forward + steering) * gain;
        float scale = Math.max(1, Math.max(Math.abs(left), Math.abs(right)));
        int limit = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, cap));
        return new int[] {motorPower(Math.round(left / scale * limit)), motorPower(Math.round(right / scale * limit))};
    }
    private static int motorPower(int command) {
        int magnitude = Math.abs(command);
        if (magnitude <= 30) return 0;
        int power = 40 + (Math.min(100, magnitude) - 30) * 60 / 70;
        return command < 0 ? -power : power;
    }
}

package com.scout.control;

import java.io.*;
import java.net.Socket;
import java.net.SocketTimeoutException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.Locale;

/** Small, bounded HTTP exchange for the fixed local robot; no proxy or connection pool. */
final class RobotHttp {
    static final class Reply {
        final int code; final String body;
        Reply(int code, String body) { this.code = code; this.body = body; }
    }
    static Reply exchange(Socket socket, String path, String body) throws IOException {
        socket.setTcpNoDelay(true);
        String payload = body == null ? "" : body;
        byte[] bytes = payload.getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
        String request = (body == null ? "GET " : "POST ") + path + " HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 192.168.4.1\r\nAccept: application/json\r\nConnection: close\r\n";
        if (body != null) request += "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\r\nContent-Length: " + bytes.length + "\r\n";
        // Header and body fit in one write, avoiding tiny separate TCP writes.
        socket.getOutputStream().write((request + "\r\n" + payload).getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII));
        long deadline = System.nanoTime() + 600_000_000L;
        BufferedInputStream input = new BufferedInputStream(socket.getInputStream());
        int[] remainingHeaders = {4096};
        String status = line(socket, input, deadline, remainingHeaders);
        String[] parts = status.split(" ", 3); int code;
        try { if (parts.length < 2 || !parts[0].startsWith("HTTP/1.")) throw new NumberFormatException(); code = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]); }
        catch (NumberFormatException e) { throw new IOException("Invalid Scout response", e); }
        int length = -1;
        while (true) {
            String header = line(socket, input, deadline, remainingHeaders);
            if (header.isEmpty()) break;
            int colon = header.indexOf(':'); if (colon < 1) throw new IOException("Invalid Scout header");
            String name = header.substring(0, colon).trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            String value = header.substring(colon + 1).trim();
            if (name.equals("content-length")) {
                if (length != -1) throw new IOException("Duplicate Scout response length");
                try { length = Integer.parseInt(value); } catch (NumberFormatException e) { throw new IOException("Invalid Scout response length", e); }
                if (length < 0 || length > 8192) throw new IOException("Scout response too large");
            }
            if (name.equals("transfer-encoding")) throw new IOException("Unsupported Scout response");
        }
        if (length < 0) throw new IOException("Missing Scout response length");
        byte[] response = new byte[length]; int count = 0;
        while (count < length) {
            timeout(socket, deadline); int n = input.read(response, count, length - count);
            if (n < 0) throw new EOFException("Truncated Scout response"); count += n;
        }
        return new Reply(code, new String(response, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }
    private static String line(Socket socket, InputStream input, long deadline, int[] remaining) throws IOException {
        ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream(); int previous = -1;
        while (remaining[0]-- > 0) {
            timeout(socket, deadline); int c = input.read(); if (c < 0) throw new EOFException("Truncated Scout headers");
            if (previous == '\r' && c == '\n') {
                byte[] bytes = out.toByteArray(); return new String(bytes, 0, bytes.length - 1, StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
            }
            out.write(c); previous = c;
        }
        throw new IOException("Scout headers too large");
    }
    private static void timeout(Socket socket, long deadline) throws IOException {
        long remaining = (deadline - System.nanoTime()) / 1_000_000;
        if (remaining <= 0) throw new SocketTimeoutException("Scout reply timed out");
        socket.setSoTimeout((int) Math.min(600, remaining));
    }
}

package com.scout.control;

import android.content.Context;
import android.net.ConnectivityManager;
import android.net.Network;
import android.net.NetworkCapabilities;
import android.net.NetworkRequest;
import android.net.LinkProperties;
import android.net.LinkAddress;
import android.net.wifi.WifiNetworkSpecifier;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.SystemClock;
import org.json.JSONObject;
import java.net.Socket;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.net.DatagramSocket;
import java.net.DatagramPacket;
import java.net.InetAddress;
import java.net.SocketTimeoutException;
import java.io.IOException;
import android.util.Log;

/** One serialized worker; the only drive sample retained is SessionState's latest pair. */
final class ScoutClient {
    interface Listener { void changed(); void calibration(boolean left, boolean right); }
    final SessionState state = new SessionState();
    final FaceSelection faces = new FaceSelection();
    private final ConnectivityManager connectivity;
    private final Handler main = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private final Listener listener;
    private final Thread worker;
    private volatile Network wifi;
    private ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback wifiRequest;
    private boolean closed, inspectPending, configPending, busy;
    private boolean configLeft, configRight;
    private long boot;
    private long nextDrive;
    private DatagramSocket udp; // Owned only by the serialized worker.
    private long lastAck, lastAckSequence;

    ScoutClient(Context context, Listener listener) {
        this.listener = listener;
        connectivity = (ConnectivityManager) context.getSystemService(Context.CONNECTIVITY_SERVICE);
        worker = new Thread(this::loop, "Scout local Wi-Fi"); worker.start();
        new Thread(this::faceLoop, "Scout face controls").start();
    }
    void connect() {
        prepareWifi(false);
    }
    private void prepareWifi(boolean calibration) {
        long epoch;
        synchronized (state) {
            if (closed || busy || state.mode == SessionState.ACTIVE || state.mode == SessionState.CONNECTING || state.mode == SessionState.WAITING_WIFI) return;
            busy = calibration;
            epoch = state.awaitWifi(SystemClock.elapsedRealtime());
        }
        changed();
        if (wifi != null && connectivity.getNetworkCapabilities(wifi) != null) {
            wifiAvailable(epoch, wifi, calibration); return;
        }
        releaseWifi(epoch);
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < 29) {
            try { wifiAvailable(epoch, findWifi(), calibration); }
            catch (Exception e) { wifiUnavailable(epoch, "Join C3-Scout-Test in Wi-Fi settings"); }
            return;
        }
        ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback callback = new ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback() {
            @Override public void onAvailable(Network network) {
                long availableEpoch; boolean begin;
                synchronized (state) {
                    if (wifiRequest != this) return;
                    availableEpoch = state.epoch; begin = state.mode == SessionState.WAITING_WIFI;
                    if (!begin) wifi = network; // Restore routing only; never resume an ended drive.
                }
                if (begin) wifiAvailable(availableEpoch, network, calibration);
            }
            @Override public void onUnavailable() {
                synchronized (state) { if (wifiRequest != this) return; }
                wifiUnavailable(epoch, "Scout Wi-Fi connection was cancelled or unavailable"); releaseWifi(this);
            }
            @Override public void onLost(Network network) {
                synchronized (state) {
                    if (wifiRequest != this || !network.equals(wifi)) return;
                    wifi = null;
                    if (state.mode == SessionState.CONNECTING) {
                        // Android 10 may replace a manual connection with an app-owned
                        // network during pairing. Retry only this still-neutral setup.
                        state.end("Scout Wi-Fi is changing"); state.awaitWifi(SystemClock.elapsedRealtime());
                    } else state.fail(state.epoch, "Scout Wi-Fi lost · reconnect when ready");
                    busy = calibration && state.mode == SessionState.WAITING_WIFI;
                }
                // Keep the app's network request alive while foreground. Recovery
                // restores only routing; an active drive that lost Wi-Fi stays ended.
                changed();
            }
        };
        synchronized (state) { if (state.epoch != epoch) return; wifiRequest = callback; }
        try {
            NetworkRequest request = new NetworkRequest.Builder().addTransportType(NetworkCapabilities.TRANSPORT_WIFI)
                .removeCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET)
                .setNetworkSpecifier(new WifiNetworkSpecifier.Builder().setSsid("C3-Scout-Test").setWpa2Passphrase("ScoutTest42").build()).build();
            // Android's approval dialog may take as long as the user needs.
            // WAITING_WIFI is neutral; Stop or leaving the app cancels it.
            connectivity.requestNetwork(request, callback);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            wifiUnavailable(epoch, "Allow Wi-Fi access and enable Location to connect to Scout"); releaseWifi(callback);
        }
    }
    private void wifiAvailable(long epoch, Network network, boolean calibration) {
        synchronized (state) {
            if (!state.wifiReady(epoch, SystemClock.elapsedRealtime())) return;
            wifi = network;
            if (calibration) { state.connectPending = false; state.mode = SessionState.OFF; inspectPending = true; state.message = "Reading motor directions…"; state.notifyAll(); }
        }
        changed();
    }
    private void wifiUnavailable(long epoch, String message) {
        synchronized (state) { if (state.epoch != epoch) return; state.fail(epoch, message); busy = false; }
        changed();
    }
    private void releaseWifi(long expectedEpoch) {
        ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback callback;
        synchronized (state) {
            if (state.epoch != expectedEpoch) return;
            callback = wifiRequest; wifiRequest = null; wifi = null;
        }
        unregisterWifi(callback);
    }
    private void releaseWifi(ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback expectedCallback) {
        synchronized (state) {
            if (wifiRequest != expectedCallback) return;
            wifiRequest = null; wifi = null;
        }
        unregisterWifi(expectedCallback);
    }
    private void unregisterWifi(ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback callback) {
        if (callback != null) { try { connectivity.unregisterNetworkCallback(callback); } catch (IllegalArgumentException ignored) { } }
    }
    void leave(String reason) {
        synchronized (state) { state.leave(reason); faces.clear(); inspectPending = configPending = false; busy = false; }
        changed();
    }
    void stop(String reason) {
        ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback cancelled = null;
        synchronized (state) {
            boolean pending = state.mode == SessionState.WAITING_WIFI; state.end(reason);
            faces.clear();
            if (pending) { busy = false; cancelled = wifiRequest; wifiRequest = null; wifi = null; }
        }
        unregisterWifi(cancelled); changed();
    }
    void input(float forward, float turn, boolean touching) { state.input(forward, turn, touching, SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()); changed(); }
    void speed(int cap) { state.speed(cap); changed(); }
    boolean busy() { synchronized (state) { return busy; } }
    void inspectCalibration() {
        prepareWifi(true);
    }
    void configure(boolean left, boolean right) {
        synchronized (state) {
            if (closed || busy || state.mode == SessionState.ACTIVE || state.mode == SessionState.CONNECTING) return;
            configLeft = left; configRight = right; busy = true; configPending = true;
            state.message = "Saving motor directions…"; state.notifyAll();
        }
        changed();
    }
    void close() { synchronized (state) { closed = true; faces.clear(); state.leave("Controller closed"); state.notifyAll(); } }
    void selectFace(int id) {
        synchronized (state) {
            if (closed || !state.active() || !faces.queue(id)) return;
            state.notifyAll();
        }
        changed();
    }
    // Face HTTP can take hundreds of milliseconds. Never do it on the UDP
    // worker, and never let a face reply update drive acknowledgments or leases.
    private void faceLoop() {
        while (true) {
            FaceSelection.Ticket ticket; Network network;
            synchronized (state) {
                if (closed) return;
                if (!state.active()) faces.pending = false;
                ticket = state.active() ? faces.take(state.epoch, state.token) : null;
                network = wifi;
                if (ticket == null) {
                    try { state.wait(100); } catch (InterruptedException ignored) { }
                    continue;
                }
            }
            try {
                if (network == null) throw new IOException("Scout Wi-Fi unavailable");
                JSONObject reply;
                try (Socket socket = network.getSocketFactory().createSocket()) {
                    socket.connect(new InetSocketAddress("192.168.4.1", 80), 600);
                    RobotHttp.Reply result = RobotHttp.exchange(socket, "/face",
                        "token=" + ticket.token + "&id=" + ticket.id);
                    if (result.code != 200) throw new IOException(result.code == 503 ?
                        "OLED unavailable · check wiring and restart Scout" : "Face not confirmed · tap to retry");
                    reply = new JSONObject(result.body);
                    validate(reply);
                    if (reply.getLong("boot") != boot || !reply.optBoolean("faceControl") ||
                        !reply.optBoolean("oledReady") || reply.getInt("face") != ticket.id)
                        throw new IOException("Face not confirmed · tap to retry");
                }
                synchronized (state) {
                    if (faces.current(ticket, state.epoch, state.active()) && ticket.token.equals(state.token))
                        faces.message = FaceSelection.label(ticket.id);
                }
            } catch (Exception failure) {
                synchronized (state) {
                    if (faces.current(ticket, state.epoch, state.active()) && ticket.token.equals(state.token))
                        faces.message = failure.getMessage() == null ? "Face not confirmed · tap to retry" : failure.getMessage();
                }
            }
            changed();
        }
    }
    private void changed() { main.post(listener::changed); }
    private void loop() {
        while (true) {
            pollDriveAck();
            int action; long epoch; String token = null; long seq = 0; int left = 0, right = 0;
            synchronized (state) {
                long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime(); state.tick(now); epoch = state.epoch;
                if (state.stopPending) { state.stopPending = false; action = 1; }
                    else if (closed) { closeUdp(); return; }
                else if (state.connectPending) { state.connectPending = false; action = 2; }
                else if (inspectPending) { inspectPending = false; action = 3; }
                else if (configPending) { configPending = false; action = 4; }
                else if (state.active() && (state.urgent || now >= nextDrive)) {
                    if (state.sequence >= 0xffffffffL) { state.end("Session complete · reconnect to drive"); continue; }
                    action = 5; token = state.token; seq = ++state.sequence;
                    int[] pair = state.takeTargetPair(); left = pair[0]; right = pair[1]; state.urgent = false; nextDrive = now + 50;
                } else {
                    try { state.wait(25); } catch (InterruptedException ignored) { }
                    continue;
                }
            }
            changed();
            try {
                if (action == 1) {
                    if (udp != null && !udp.isClosed()) {
                        byte[] stop=DriveDatagram.encode(true,DriveDatagram.ZERO_TOKEN,0,0,0);
                        try {
                            for(int repeat=0;repeat<3;++repeat)udp.send(new DatagramPacket(stop,stop.length));
                        } catch (IOException error) {
                            Log.w("ScoutLink", "Packet STOP failed; trying HTTP STOP", error);
                        }
                    }
                    JSONObject result = request("/stop", ""); validate(result);
                } else if (action == 2) {
                    closeUdp();
                    if (wifi == null) wifi = findWifi();
                    JSONObject status = request("/status", null); validate(status);
                    if (!status.getBoolean("ready")) throw new Exception("Scout is not ready");
                    synchronized (state) { if (state.epoch != epoch || state.mode != SessionState.CONNECTING) continue; }
                    JSONObject session = request("/session", ""); validate(session);
                    if (!session.getBoolean("ready") || !session.getBoolean("connected") || session.getBoolean("enabled") || session.getInt("left") != 0 || session.getInt("right") != 0)
                        throw new Exception("Scout did not create a neutral session");
                    DatagramSocket socket = new DatagramSocket();
                    try { wifi.bindSocket(socket); socket.connect(InetAddress.getByName("192.168.4.1"),DriveDatagram.PORT); socket.setSoTimeout(1); }
                    catch(Exception e){socket.close();throw e;}
                    synchronized (state) {
                        state.tick(SystemClock.elapsedRealtime());
                        if (state.acceptSession(epoch, session.getString("token"))) {
                            boot = session.getLong("boot"); udp=socket;lastAck=SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();lastAckSequence=0;
                            faces.initialize(session.optBoolean("faceControl"), session.optBoolean("oledReady"), session.optInt("face", -1));
                        } else { socket.close(); if (state.epoch == epoch) throw new Exception("Invalid Scout session token"); }
                    }
                } else if (action == 3) {
                    if (wifi == null) wifi = findWifi(); JSONObject status = request("/status", null); validate(status);
                    if (status.getBoolean("connected")) throw new Exception("Scout has a live session · press STOP first");
                    boolean l = status.getBoolean("leftReversed"), r = status.getBoolean("rightReversed");
                    synchronized (state) {
                        if (state.epoch == epoch) {
                            state.message = "Motor directions ready";
                            main.post(() -> { synchronized (state) { if (state.epoch != epoch || state.active() || state.mode == SessionState.CONNECTING) return; } listener.calibration(l, r); });
                        }
                    }
                } else if (action == 4) {
                    if (wifi == null) wifi = findWifi();
                    JSONObject status = request("/config", "leftReversed=" + (configLeft ? 1 : 0) + "&rightReversed=" + (configRight ? 1 : 0)); validate(status);
                    if (status.getBoolean("connected") || status.getBoolean("enabled")) throw new Exception("Scout did not confirm stopped calibration");
                    synchronized (state) { if (state.epoch == epoch) state.message = "Motor directions saved"; }
                } else {
                    if(udp==null)throw new IOException("Drive channel unavailable");
                    byte[] command=DriveDatagram.encode(false,token,seq,left,right);
                    udp.send(new DatagramPacket(command,command.length));
                }
            } catch (Exception error) {
                String detail = error.getMessage();
                Log.w("ScoutLink", "Request " + action + " failed: " + error.getClass().getSimpleName() + ": " + detail);
                if (error instanceof IOException) detail = "Scout link interrupted · check the robot's power and Wi-Fi";
                if (detail == null || detail.isEmpty()) detail = "Wi-Fi request failed";
                synchronized (state) {
                    if (action != 1) state.fail(epoch, detail + " · reconnect when ready");
                    else if (state.epoch == epoch && state.mode == SessionState.OFF)
                        state.message = "Stop unconfirmed · check Scout's Wi-Fi connection";
                }
            } finally {
                if(action==1)closeUdp();
                ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback released = null;
                synchronized (state) {
                    // Consume cleanup and detach its exact request atomically. A later
                    // Stop or Connect cannot consume cleanup or replace this callback.
                    if (action == 1 && state.takeWifiCleanup(epoch)) {
                        released = wifiRequest; wifiRequest = null; wifi = null;
                    }
                    if (action == 3 || action == 4) busy = false;
                }
                unregisterWifi(released);
                changed();
            }
        }
    }
    private void closeUdp(){if(udp!=null){udp.close();udp=null;}}
    private void pollDriveAck(){
        if(udp==null)return;
        synchronized(state){if(!state.active())return;}
        long epoch;String token;
        synchronized(state){epoch=state.epoch;token=state.token;}
        try {
            for(int i=0;i<8;++i){
                byte[] bytes=new byte[128];DatagramPacket packet=new DatagramPacket(bytes,bytes.length);udp.receive(packet);
                DriveDatagram.Ack ack=DriveDatagram.decode(bytes,packet.getLength());
                if(ack==null||!ack.token.equals(token))continue;
                synchronized(state){
                    if(!state.acceptDrive(epoch))return;
                    if(ack.boot!=boot||(ack.flags&3)!=3||ack.code==2||ack.code==3){state.fail(epoch,"Scout session ended · reconnect");break;}
                    if(ack.code==0&&ack.sequence>lastAckSequence&&ack.sequence<=state.sequence){lastAckSequence=ack.sequence;lastAck=SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();}
                }
            }
        }catch(SocketTimeoutException normal){ }
        catch(IOException failure){synchronized(state){state.fail(epoch,"Scout drive link lost · reconnect");}}
        synchronized(state){if(state.acceptDrive(epoch)&&SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()-lastAck>=400)state.fail(epoch,"Scout replies lost · reconnect when ready");}
    }
    private Network findWifi() throws Exception {
        for (Network network : connectivity.getAllNetworks()) {
            NetworkCapabilities c = connectivity.getNetworkCapabilities(network);
            if (c != null && c.hasTransport(NetworkCapabilities.TRANSPORT_WIFI) && !c.hasTransport(NetworkCapabilities.TRANSPORT_VPN)) {
                LinkProperties properties = connectivity.getLinkProperties(network);
                if (properties != null) for (LinkAddress address : properties.getLinkAddresses())
                    if (address.getAddress().getHostAddress().startsWith("192.168.4.")) return network;
            }
        }
        throw new Exception("Join C3-Scout-Test in Wi-Fi settings");
    }
    private JSONObject request(String path, String body) throws Exception {
        long started = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        if (wifi == null) wifi = findWifi();
        try (Socket socket = wifi.getSocketFactory().createSocket()) {
            socket.connect(new InetSocketAddress("192.168.4.1", 80), 600);
            RobotHttp.Reply reply = RobotHttp.exchange(socket, path, body);
            if (reply.code != 200) throw new Exception(reply.code == 409 ? "Scout session conflict or expired lease" : "Scout request rejected (" + reply.code + ")");
            return new JSONObject(reply.body);
        } finally {
            long elapsed = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - started;
            if (elapsed > 150) Log.i("ScoutLink", path + " reply took " + elapsed + " ms");
        }
    }
    private static void validate(JSONObject j) throws Exception {
        if (j.optInt("protocol", -1) != 2 || !"SCOUT 2".equals(j.optString("version")) || j.optInt("timeoutMs", 0) != 400 || j.optInt("drivePort",0)!=DriveDatagram.PORT)
            throw new Exception("Firmware update needed · install SCOUT 2");
        long boot = j.getLong("boot");
        if (boot < 0 || boot > 0xffffffffL || Math.abs((long) j.getInt("left")) > 100 || Math.abs((long) j.getInt("right")) > 100)
            throw new Exception("Invalid Scout response");
        j.getBoolean("ready"); j.getBoolean("connected"); j.getBoolean("enabled");
        j.getBoolean("leftReversed"); j.getBoolean("rightReversed"); j.getString("message");
    }
}

package com.scout.control;

/** All fields are guarded by this object, including the serial worker's selections. */
final class SessionState {
    static final int OFF = 0, CONNECTING = 1, ACTIVE = 2, ERROR = 3, WAITING_WIFI = 4;
    int mode, left, right, cap = 35;
    long epoch, lastUi, sequence;
    String token, message = "Ready when you are";
    boolean touching, urgent, stopPending, connectPending, releasePending, releaseWifiPending, leaving;
    float forward, turn;
    synchronized long awaitWifi(long now) {
        clear(); epoch++; lastUi = now; mode = WAITING_WIFI; connectPending = false; releaseWifiPending = false; leaving = false;
        message = "Choose Scout in the Android Wi-Fi prompt"; notifyAll(); return epoch;
    }
    synchronized boolean wifiReady(long requestEpoch, long now) {
        if (epoch != requestEpoch || mode != WAITING_WIFI) return false;
        lastUi = now; mode = CONNECTING; connectPending = true;
        message = "Checking Scout firmware…"; notifyAll(); return true;
    }
    synchronized long connect(long now) {
        clear(); epoch++; lastUi = now; mode = CONNECTING; leaving = false;
        connectPending = true; message = "Checking Scout firmware…"; notifyAll(); return epoch;
    }
    synchronized boolean acceptSession(long requestEpoch, String newToken) {
        if (epoch != requestEpoch || mode != CONNECTING) return false;
        if (newToken == null || !newToken.matches("[0-9a-fA-F]{32}")) return false;
        token = newToken; sequence = 0; mode = ACTIVE; urgent = true;
        message = "Connected · touch to drive"; return true;
    }
    synchronized boolean acceptDrive(long requestEpoch) { return epoch == requestEpoch && mode == ACTIVE; }
    synchronized void input(float f, float t, boolean touch, long now) {
        tick(now);
        if (!active()) return;
        forward = touch ? f : 0; turn = touch ? t : 0; touching = touch; lastUi = now;
        mix(); if (!touch) { urgent = true; releasePending = true; } notifyAll();
    }
    synchronized void speed(int value) { cap = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, value)); mix(); }
    synchronized void heartbeat(long now) { tick(now); lastUi = now; }
    synchronized void tick(long now) {
        if ((mode == ACTIVE || mode == CONNECTING) && now - lastUi > 250) end("Input paused · reconnect to drive");
    }
    synchronized void end(String reason) {
        epoch++; clear(); connectPending = false; mode = OFF; message = reason;
        stopPending = true; notifyAll();
    }
    synchronized void leave(String reason) {
        if (leaving) return;
        leaving = true;
        end(reason); releaseWifiPending = true;
    }
    synchronized void fail(long requestEpoch, String reason) {
        if (epoch != requestEpoch) return;
        end(reason); mode = ERROR;
    }
    private void clear() { forward = turn = 0; left = right = 0; touching = false; token = null; urgent = true; releasePending = false; }
    private void mix() { int[] p = Mixer.mix(forward, turn, cap); left = p[0]; right = p[1]; }
    synchronized boolean active() { return mode == ACTIVE; }
    synchronized int[] takeTargetPair() {
        if (releasePending) { releasePending = false; return new int[] {0, 0}; }
        return new int[] {left, right};
    }
    synchronized boolean takeWifiCleanup(long requestEpoch) {
        if (epoch != requestEpoch || !releaseWifiPending) return false;
        releaseWifiPending = false; return true;
    }
}

package com.scout.control;

public final class ControlTests {
    private static int checks;
    static void equal(int want, int got, String why) { checks++; if (want != got) throw new AssertionError(why + ": expected " + want + ", got " + got); }
    static void yes(boolean value, String why) { checks++; if (!value) throw new AssertionError(why); }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int[] out = Mixer.mix(1, 0, 35);
        equal(44, out[0], "35 percent drive maps to useful motor power"); equal(44, out[1], "Forward is symmetric");
        out = Mixer.mix(-1, 0, 35); equal(-44, out[0], "Reverse sign"); equal(-44, out[1], "Reverse symmetry");
        out = Mixer.mix(0, 1, 60); equal(-65, out[0], "Right stick reverses left target for Scout's corrected polarity"); equal(65, out[1], "Right stick advances right target");
        out = Mixer.mix(0, -1, 60); equal(65, out[0], "Left stick advances left target"); equal(-65, out[1], "Left stick reverses right target");
        out = Mixer.mix(1, 1, 35); equal(0, out[0], "Forward right arc inner target stays off"); equal(44, out[1], "Forward right arc uses useful power");
        out = Mixer.mix(1, -1, 35); equal(44, out[0], "Forward left arc uses useful power"); equal(0, out[1], "Forward left arc inner target stays off");
        out = Mixer.mix(-1, 1, 35); equal(0, out[0], "Reverse right arc inner target stays off"); equal(-44, out[1], "Reverse right arc follows steering in reverse");
        out = Mixer.mix(-1, -1, 35); equal(-44, out[0], "Reverse left arc follows steering in reverse"); equal(0, out[1], "Reverse left arc inner target stays off");
        out = Mixer.mix(.03f, .04f, 100); equal(0, out[0], "Radial dead zone"); equal(0, out[1], "Radial dead zone symmetry");
        out = Mixer.mix(.5f, 0, 100); equal(53, out[0], "Analog command uses the useful motor range");
        out = Mixer.mix(1, 0, 0); equal(0, out[0], "Zero cap");
        out = Mixer.mix(1, 0, 30); equal(0, out[0], "30 percent is off");
        out = Mixer.mix(-1, 0, 30); equal(0, out[0], "Negative 30 percent is off");
        out = Mixer.mix(1, 0, 31); equal(40, out[0], "First active percent starts at 40 percent motor power");
        out = Mixer.mix(1, 0, 65); equal(70, out[0], "Middle drive range maps proportionally");
        out = Mixer.mix(1, 0, 100); equal(100, out[0], "Full command stays full power");
        int previous = 0;
        for (int cap = 0; cap <= 100; cap++) {
            int forward = Mixer.mix(1, 0, cap)[0], reverse = Mixer.mix(-1, 0, cap)[0];
            yes(cap > 30 || forward == 0, "Entire low range remains off");
            yes(forward == 0 || (forward >= 40 && forward <= 100), "Never command stalled low motor power");
            yes(reverse == -forward, "Mapping preserves reverse symmetry");
            yes(forward >= previous, "Mapping is monotonic"); previous = forward;
        }
        System.out.println("PASS " + checks + " mixer checks");
    }
}

import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
public final class DatagramTests {
    static void yes(boolean v,String why){if(!v)throw new AssertionError(why);}
    public static void main(String[] args){
        String token="0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef";
        byte[] p=DriveDatagram.encode(false,token,0xffffffffL,-44,100);
        yes(p.length==45&&p[3]=='2'&&p[4]=='D',"Drive framing");
        ByteBuffer b=ByteBuffer.wrap(p);yes((b.getInt(37)&0xffffffffL)==0xffffffffL&&b.getShort(41)==-44&&b.getShort(43)==100,"Signed targets and unsigned sequence");
        p=DriveDatagram.encode(true,DriveDatagram.ZERO_TOKEN,0,0,0);yes(p[4]=='S',"Stop requires no live session");
        byte[] ack=ByteBuffer.allocate(50).put(new byte[]{'A','C','K','2'}).put(token.getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII)).putInt(7).put((byte)0).putInt(0xfedcba98).put((byte)3).putShort((short)-44).putShort((short)100).array();
        DriveDatagram.Ack a=DriveDatagram.decode(ack,50);
        yes(a!=null&&a.token.equals(token)&&a.sequence==7&&a.boot==0xfedcba98L&&a.left==-44&&a.right==100,"Ack identity and targets");
        yes(DriveDatagram.decode(ack,49)==null,"Truncated ack ignored");ack[3]='1';yes(DriveDatagram.decode(ack,50)==null,"Old protocol ignored");
        boolean rejected=false;try{DriveDatagram.encode(false,token,1,101,0);}catch(IllegalArgumentException e){rejected=true;}
        yes(rejected,"Invalid target rejected");
        System.out.println("PASS packet framing, session identity, sequence, signs and rejection checks");
    }
}

package com.scout.control;

public final class FaceTests {
    static void check(boolean ok) { if (!ok) throw new AssertionError(); }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        FaceSelection f = new FaceSelection();
        check(!f.queue(1));
        f.initialize(true, true, -1);
        check(f.queue(1)); check(f.queue(8));
        FaceSelection.Ticket t = f.take(7, "token");
        check(t.id == 8 && t.epoch == 7 && t.token.equals("token"));
        check(f.take(7, "token") == null);
        check(!f.current(t, 8, true)); check(!f.current(t, 7, false));
        check(f.queue(-1)); check(!f.current(t, 7, true));
        FaceSelection.Ticket auto = f.take(7, "token");
        check(auto.id == -1 && f.current(auto, 7, true));
        check(!f.queue(10)); check(f.current(auto, 7, true));
        f.clear(); check(!f.current(auto, 7, true)); check(!f.queue(2));
        f.initialize(false, false, -1); check(!f.queue(2));
        f.initialize(true, false, -1); check(!f.queue(2));
        System.out.println("Face selection: coalescing, stale results, lifecycle and bounds passed");
    }
}

package com.scout.control;

import java.io.*;
import java.net.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

public final class HttpTests {
    static void yes(boolean value, String why) { if (!value) throw new AssertionError(why); }
    static RobotHttp.Reply exchange(String response, int delay) throws Exception {
        try (ServerSocket server = new ServerSocket(0)) {
            Throwable[] failure = new Throwable[1];
            Thread peer = new Thread(() -> {
                try (Socket socket = server.accept()) {
                    socket.setSoTimeout(1000);
                    InputStream in = socket.getInputStream(); ByteArrayOutputStream headers = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
                    int c; String h;
                    do { c = in.read(); if (c < 0) throw new EOFException(); headers.write(c); h = headers.toString("US-ASCII"); } while (!h.endsWith("\r\n\r\n"));
                    yes(h.startsWith("POST /drive HTTP/1.1\r\n"), "Correct request line");
                    yes(h.contains("Content-Length: 6\r\n"), "Exact body length");
                    byte[] body = new byte[6]; int count = 0;
                    while (count < 6) { int n = in.read(body, count, 6-count); if (n < 0) throw new EOFException(); count += n; }
                    yes(new String(body, StandardCharsets.US_ASCII).equals("left=0"), "Complete command body arrives");
                    Thread.sleep(delay); socket.getOutputStream().write(response.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
                } catch (Throwable e) { failure[0] = e; }
            }); peer.start();
            try (Socket socket = new Socket("127.0.0.1", server.getLocalPort())) {
                try { return RobotHttp.exchange(socket, "/drive", "left=0"); }
                finally { peer.join(2000); if (failure[0] != null) throw new AssertionError(failure[0]); }
            }
        }
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        RobotHttp.Reply reply = exchange("HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 2\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n{}", 300);
        yes(reply.code == 200 && reply.body.equals("{}"), "A delayed reply above the old 200ms limit is read completely");
        reply = exchange("HTTP/1.1 409 Conflict\r\ncontent-length: 4\r\n\r\nstop", 0);
        yes(reply.code == 409 && reply.body.equals("stop"), "Firmware rejection is preserved");
        boolean rejected = false;
        try { exchange("HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 5\r\n\r\n{}", 0); } catch (EOFException e) { rejected = true; }
        yes(rejected, "Truncated response rejected");
        rejected = false;
        try { exchange("HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 99999\r\n\r\n", 0); } catch (IOException e) { rejected = true; }
        yes(rejected, "Unbounded response rejected");
        rejected = false;
        try { exchange("HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\n{}", 0); } catch (IOException e) { rejected = true; }
        yes(rejected, "Missing length rejected");
        System.out.println("PASS direct HTTP, delayed response, rejection, truncation and bounds checks");
    }
}

package com.scout.control;

public final class SessionTests {
    static void yes(boolean value, String why) { if (!value) throw new AssertionError(why); }
    static SessionState connected(long now) {
        SessionState s = new SessionState();
        long epoch = s.connect(now);
        yes(s.acceptSession(epoch, "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"), "Connect must accept its neutral session");
        return s;
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        SessionState s = connected(1000);
        yes(s.left == 0 && s.right == 0, "Connect creates zero targets");
        s.input(1, 0, true, 1010); yes(s.left == 44 && s.right == 44, "New touch allows remapped driving");
        s.input(0, 0, false, 1020); yes(s.left == 0 && s.right == 0 && s.urgent, "Release schedules zero promptly");
        s.input(1, 0, true, 1030); long old = s.epoch;
        s.end("Stopped"); yes(!s.acceptSession(old, "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"), "In-flight connect cannot resurrect stopped session");
        yes(!s.acceptDrive(old), "In-flight drive response cannot undo STOP");
        yes(s.left == 0 && s.right == 0 && s.stopPending, "Stop clears input and schedules global stop");
        s.input(1, 0, true, 1050); yes(s.left == 0, "Disconnected input ignored");
        long next = s.connect(1100); s.acceptSession(next, "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef");
        yes(s.left == 0 && !s.touching, "Reconnect requires new touch");
        s.input(1, 0, true, 1110); s.tick(1361);
        yes(!s.active() && s.stopPending && s.left == 0, "Frozen UI expires held command");
        s = connected(2000); s.input(1, 0, true, 2010); s.heartbeat(2220); s.tick(2400);
        yes(s.active(), "Responsive UI can hold a stationary touch");
        s.tick(2471); yes(!s.active(), "Heartbeat deadline must not renew on worker ticks");
        s = connected(3000); old = s.epoch; s.fail(old, "Network lost");
        yes(!s.active() && s.stopPending && s.left == 0, "Network failure ends session");
        s.connect(3100); s.fail(old, "Old request failure"); yes(s.mode == SessionState.CONNECTING, "Obsolete failure cannot cancel newer Connect");
        s = connected(4000); s.input(1,0,true,4010); s.speed(10); yes(s.left == 0, "Changing cap below threshold stops held target");
        s.end("Paused"); s.speed(100); yes(s.left == 0, "Speed change cannot restart paused session");
        s = connected(5000); s.input(1,0,true,5010); s.heartbeat(5300);
        yes(!s.active() && s.left == 0, "A UI heartbeat returning after its deadline cannot revive an old touch");
        s = connected(6000); s.input(1,0,true,6010); s.input(1,0,true,6300);
        yes(!s.active() && s.left == 0, "A delayed touch event cannot refresh an expired session");
        s = connected(7000); s.input(1,0,true,7010); s.input(0,0,false,7020); s.input(-1,0,true,7030);
        int[] pair = s.takeTargetPair();
        yes(pair[0] == 0 && pair[1] == 0, "Rapid retouch cannot overwrite release's immediate zero");
        pair = s.takeTargetPair(); yes(pair[0] == -44 && pair[1] == -44, "After release zero the worker samples the latest touch");
        s = new SessionState(); old = s.awaitWifi(8000); s.heartbeat(10000); s.tick(20000);
        yes(s.mode == SessionState.WAITING_WIFI && s.left == 0, "System Wi-Fi prompt may wait without driving or UI expiry");
        yes(s.wifiReady(old, 20001), "Only the current Wi-Fi request may begin connecting");
        yes(s.mode == SessionState.CONNECTING && s.connectPending, "Wi-Fi availability begins a neutral connection");
        s = new SessionState(); old = s.awaitWifi(21000); s.end("Cancelled");
        yes(!s.wifiReady(old, 21001), "Late Wi-Fi callback cannot undo Stop");
        s = connected(22000); s.end("Paused"); s.releaseWifiPending = true; old = s.epoch;
        s.end("Hidden"); s.releaseWifiPending = true;
        yes(!s.takeWifiCleanup(old), "An older in-flight Stop cannot consume newer network cleanup");
        yes(s.releaseWifiPending, "Current Stop still owns the pending cleanup");
        yes(s.takeWifiCleanup(s.epoch) && !s.releaseWifiPending, "Current Stop consumes cleanup exactly once");
        s.releaseWifiPending = true; old = s.epoch; s.awaitWifi(23000);
        yes(!s.takeWifiCleanup(old) && !s.releaseWifiPending, "New explicit Connect supersedes old network cleanup");
        s = new SessionState(); old = s.awaitWifi(24000); s.wifiReady(old,24001);
        s.end("Network replaced during neutral setup"); next = s.awaitWifi(24002);
        yes(!s.acceptSession(old,"0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"), "Replaced setup cannot accept an old session reply");
        yes(s.wifiReady(next,24003) && s.left == 0 && s.right == 0, "Network replacement can only retry neutral setup");
        s = connected(25000); s.input(1,0,true,25001); s.leave("Paused"); old = s.epoch;
        yes(s.left == 0 && s.stopPending && s.releaseWifiPending, "Leaving schedules stop and Wi-Fi cleanup");
        s.leave("Hidden");
        yes(s.epoch == old, "Repeated lifecycle exit must preserve the in-flight Stop owner");
        s.stopPending = false; yes(s.takeWifiCleanup(old), "First exit owns network cleanup");
        s.leave("Destroyed");
        yes(!s.stopPending && !s.releaseWifiPending, "Later exit cannot queue Stop after Wi-Fi was released");
        next = s.awaitWifi(26000); s.wifiReady(next,26001); s.acceptSession(next,"0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef");
        s.leave("Paused again");
        yes(s.stopPending && s.releaseWifiPending, "Explicit reconnect permits a new lifecycle Stop");
        System.out.println("PASS session lifecycle, stale-response, reconnect, release and freshness checks");
    }
}

# Scout browser control

The ESP32-C3 serves the complete controller itself. No Android app, internet,
account, CDN or cloud hosting is required. Use a modern browser on a phone,
tablet or computer.

## Start driving

1. Unplug ESP USB before switching RUN on, following Scout's existing power procedure.
2. Join Wi-Fi **C3-Scout-Test**, password **ScoutTest42**. Stay connected if the
   device says this network has no internet.
3. Open **http://192.168.4.1/** (HTTP, not HTTPS), then press **Connect**.
4. Drag the joystick; release to send zero. Default drive limit is 35%. The
   existing power mapping remains: logical 0–30% is off; above 30% maps to
   physical motor targets of 40–100%.
5. Press **Stop** to stop and end the session. Reconnect deliberately to drive again.

Auto cycles ten animated faces. Tap a named expression to keep that face's
blinking/glancing animation. Swipe the face row for all choices. OLED absence
disables face controls while leaving driving available.

**Motor directions** is an expandable section below the controls; scroll if
needed. Stop first, choose Reverse left/right motor, and save. Settings persist
on Scout. Existing saved values were preserved. Stop remains pinned at the
bottom in portrait and landscape. Arrow keys work while the joystick has focus;
releasing a key sends zero, and Space stops the session.

## Safety and compatibility

The browser, Android app and HTTP protocol share the same single DriveCore
session: only one can drive at a time. Observers cannot claim an existing
session. Closing an observing or obsolete browser connection cannot stop a
newer owner. The Android protocol-2 app and UDP interface remain supported.

Browser sessions use an independent 1000 ms motor lease and hardware-enable
cutoff; Android sessions retain 400 ms. The browser additionally stops after
800 ms without a fresh drive
acknowledgement, a stalled UI (over 250 ms), lost socket, hidden page, window focus loss or page exit. It
does not automatically resume after reconnecting. A release sends zero
immediately, ahead of a new touch; that touch must wait for zero acknowledgement.
The browser sends the current target every 100 ms independently of reply latency.
It bounds unsent socket data to 256 bytes and tracks recent sent sequences so
duplicate, future or stale acknowledgements cannot renew reply freshness.

Only drive packets renew the lease. Face changes, status requests, WebSocket
pings and calibration do not. Calibration holds ready=false while writing
preferences, preventing a concurrent browser/Android session from starting.
HTTP page transfers, WebSocket IO and OLED rendering run outside the motor loop
and independent safety timer. This is the existing software cutoff, not a
certified mechanical stopping-time guarantee.

## Firmware and protocol

Sources: `firmware/web/index.html`, `control-core.js`, `control-app.js`.
`scripts/build-web-control.py` produces deterministic gzip data in
`firmware/ScoutDrive/WebControlPage.h` and a readable preview in
`artifacts/web-control/index.html`. `scripts/build-firmware.ps1` generates it
automatically. Install Arduino **WebSockets 2.7.2** (Links2004/Markus Sattler),
plus the existing Adafruit SSD1306/GFX dependencies and local ScoutFaces library.
WebSockets dependency/reference: https://github.com/Links2004/arduinoWebSockets

GET / returns the self-contained compressed page with no-store caching.
WebSocket port 81 uses subprotocol `arduino`; the Origin must be exactly
`http://192.168.4.1`. The browser port is local to Scout's Wi-Fi network.

- Text `C`: request a fresh neutral session; success returns status with a
  32-character token and boot ID. Busy/unavailable returns an error.
- Binary 45-byte `SCT2D` frames: existing protocol-2 token, big-endian sequence,
  signed left/right motor targets. A reply contains status plus matching `ack`.
  Frames require both the socket's ownership and the current session token.
- Text `F,-1` or `F,0` through `F,9`: select Auto or a face; no lease renewal.
- Text `S`: end only this socket's owned session. Disconnect also releases that
  session. Invalid application frames release an owned session.
- Direction changes use the existing stopped-only HTTP POST /config endpoint.

Status adds `browserControl:true`. Firmware retains SCOUT 2 / protocol 2 identity.
No partition changes are required. Previous firmware images are saved under
`artifacts/recovery/Before-Web-Control-2026-10-18`.

## Verified 18 October 2026

- Firmware: 1,181,613 bytes application flash (90%); 40,792 bytes static RAM (12%).
  Uploaded to COM3 with flash hashes verified. Final application SHA256:
  `f63a578b4ac9d855ed778770c1cd9ab61de0998844ce00985fad0e0c5d5fdbc7`.
- 308 firmware host checks, ScoutFaces timeline checks, and browser-core tests
  passed (mixing/framing, one outstanding frame, release gating, neutrality,
  stale acknowledgements, restart, visibility and UI freshness).
- Browser UI checked at 390×844, 375×667 and 844×390. Face row and joystick stay
  above the pinned Stop button; drive, face selection and release work, and
  calibration is locked while active.
- Real Chromium browser loaded the page from Scout over Wi-Fi and sent
  +44%/+44% commands while selecting Happy, Dizzy and Auto. OLED remained ready.
  Release sent zero without ending the session; Stop ended it. Saving unchanged
  motor directions preserved both existing reverse settings.
- Device checks passed: Android HTTP session exclusion, observer exclusion,
  400 ms lease expiry after a single drive packet, obsolete socket disconnect
  preserving a newer Android-style session, owner disconnect stop, malformed
  frame stop, and rejection of a foreign WebSocket Origin.
- RUN remained OPEN. These were software/electrical bench checks, not powered
  driving, visual animation measurement or radio-range tests. Safari/Firefox
  were not separately device-tested. Final state: zero targets, driver off,
  disconnected, OLED Auto. Host Wi-Fi restored to WC_White.

Results/screenshots: `artifacts/verification/web-control/`. Host/UI test helpers:
`firmware/tests/web-control.test.cjs`, `scripts/test-web-control-ui.cjs`.
`scripts/bench-web-control.ps1` temporarily joins Scout Wi-Fi and always requests
restoration of the original profile. Supply `-RestoreProfile` on another host.

## Settings-related disconnect fix (18 October 2026)

A reproduced browser bug ended the session whenever joystick release found any
WebSocket send backlog, even one ordinary 45-byte drive frame. Speed changes
and moving focus from the joystick to a face button can trigger release, so a
healthy connection could be reported as delayed during those actions.

Release now queues its immediate zero through the same bounded send check used
by other commands. The excessive-backlog cutoff, zero-acknowledgement gate,
250 ms browser checks and independent 400 ms firmware lease are unchanged.
There is no automatic movement restart.

Regression coverage is in `firmware/tests/web-settings.test.cjs`: normal buffered
release on speed/focus change must remain connected and send zero; excessive
backlog must still disconnect. Seven browser test groups, 308 firmware host
checks and the three browser viewport checks passed. This fixes a reproduced
client-side cause; it does not establish the cause of every reported random
disconnect. Uploaded to COM3 with flash verification. Serial checks confirmed ready, OLED ready, unchanged boot and disabled zero motor targets. The computer could not see C3-Scout-Test even after a fresh Wi-Fi scan, so wireless stress verification remains pending; local tests do not establish that all radio/session drops are resolved.

## Reverse steering correction (19 October 2026)

The operator reported correct straight forward/reverse and stationary left/right,
but reversed steering while backing up. Both browser and Android mixers used a
fixed steering differential regardless of travel direction. They now reverse the
steering contribution only when the forward input is negative. Straight travel,
forward arcs, stationary turns, motor calibration and stop behavior are preserved.

Regression tests reproduced the old reverse-right wheel pair [-44, 0] and now
require [0, -44]; reverse-left similarly changes to [-44, 0]. Browser tests also
check both forward arcs and stationary turns, plus bounded motor output across
all speed caps. All eight browser test groups, 429 Android mixer checks and the
308 firmware host checks passed; Android session, HTTP, packet and face tests
passed. Updated software requires installation before physical confirmation.

Both updated builds completed successfully. The Android APK signature verified;
firmware uses 1,181,757 bytes of flash and 40,792 bytes of global RAM. Installation
and physical reverse-turn confirmation are pending the operator's setup check.

ESP installation completed on COM3 after the operator confirmed RUN OPEN and USB
connected. Upload hashes verified. Serial status confirmed ready=true,
enabled=false, left=0, right=0, OLED ready, browser control available and both
saved motor reverse flags still true. Phone installation was skipped at the
operator's request. Physical reverse-turn confirmation remains pending.

The operator confirmed corrected physical steering but reports repeated browser
disconnects showing "Scout link delayed · reconnect". That message conflates
closed transport with bufferedAmount >256. Split these into "Scout connection
closed" and "Scout send queue stalled (N bytes)" to identify the failing branch.
Nine browser test groups pass. This is diagnostic only; no disconnect root cause
has been established, and timeout/backlog protections remain unchanged.

## Delayed replies while driving (19 October 2026)

The operator clarified the actual message as "Scout replies delayed" while using
the joystick. The old browser sent a single command then waited for its reply;
it disconnected if that reply took over 250 ms, before the firmware's 400 ms
lease. A deterministic 300 ms reply-latency regression reproduced stalled command
updates. The browser now transmits the current pair every 50 ms independently of
replies, while keeping the existing 256-byte unsent queue limit. It stops after
400 ms without fresh acknowledged progress. Only increasing, actually sent
sequences younger than 400 ms can update reply freshness. Zero release still
blocks new motion until that zero or a later zero has been acknowledged.
The firmware's independent 400 ms cutoff and hidden/stalled-page stops remain.

All 11 browser test groups, 308 firmware host checks, and three browser viewport
checks passed. This corrects the reproduced sensitivity to reply latency;
physical wireless confirmation remains pending. Separate closed-connection and
send-queue diagnostics are included. No phone changes are part of this update.

Installed the delayed-reply correction on COM3 after fresh operator confirmation
of RUN OPEN and ESP USB connected. Upload hash verification passed. Serial status
confirmed ready, disconnected, driver disabled, zero left/right targets, OLED
ready, browser controller available, both saved reverse flags true. Browser must
be reloaded to load the revised JavaScript. Powered wireless driving confirmation
remains pending; phone app was not installed.


## Timeout adjustment (19 October 2026)

At the operator's request, browser updates now run every 100 ms, reply freshness
is limited to 800 ms, and browser-owned ESP sessions expire after 1000 ms without
a valid command. Release and Stop remain immediate; UI stall (250 ms), hidden
page, focus-loss and send-backlog checks remain. Maximum continued motor drive
after command loss is now one second for browser sessions. Android sessions
retain their 400 ms timeout and existing app compatibility. The status API keeps
timeoutMs=400 for Android and adds browserTimeoutMs=1000; the browser requires
the latter value before driving. Session acquisition always resets the timeout
for the new controller, and observing or conflicting clients cannot change it.

Verification: 12 browser test groups, 310 firmware checks, all Android host suites
and three browser viewport checks passed. Tests cover 600 ms delayed replies,
100 ms command cadence, the exact 800 ms browser reply cutoff, the exact 1000 ms
ESP browser expiry, and returning to 400 ms on the next Android session.

Timing update installed on COM3 after the operator explicitly confirmed RUN
physically OPEN and ESP USB connected. Flash hash verification passed. Serial
startup confirmed ready, driver disabled, zero motor targets, saved motor
calibration preserved, OLED ready and browserTimeoutMs=1000 (Android timeoutMs
remains 400). Reload the browser controller to load the 100 ms update cadence and
800 ms reply timeout. Wireless driving confirmation remains pending.


Operator follow-up after the timing update: direction is confirmed correct and
driving is reported to work "way better." This confirms improvement on Scout;
long-duration wireless stability and range remain unqualified. Documentation
and public software packages are being updated to this installed build.
