# Scout Control 1.2.0: faces while driving

The regular SCOUT 2 firmware now runs ScoutFaces in an optional independent
low-priority task. The joystick, UDP motor packets and 400 ms lease remain
protocol 2. The Android face-request worker is separate from the drive worker.

Use the Auto and ten named face buttons above Stop. Swipe horizontally to see
the full list. A chosen expression keeps blinking/glancing until another is
selected; Auto cycles all ten. Face controls enable only after connecting to
firmware that advertises the feature and detects the OLED. App 1.2.0 can still
drive older SCOUT 2 firmware, with face buttons disabled. Older apps can drive
this firmware, with automatic OLED faces by default.

OLED: SSD1306 128×64, VCC=3V3, GND=GND, SDA=GPIO5, SCL=GPIO7. Firmware probes
0x3C and 0x3D at 100 kHz. No OLED, an initialization failure, or a disconnected
OLED disables the face renderer while leaving driving available. Repair the
wiring and reset Scout to retry. The display task owns Wire and the framebuffer;
no I2C transfer runs in the motor loop, HTTP task or safety timer.

## API extension

Status/session JSON adds `faceControl` (true), `oledReady` (boolean), and `face`
(-1 for Auto, 0..9 for a selected expression). These describe the requested
selection, not an optical check of the screen. Expression order matches the
ScoutFaces library: Happy, Laughing, Surprised, Angry, Sad, Sleepy, Skeptical,
Winking, Cheeky, Dizzy.

`POST /face`, form `token=<current session token>&id=-1` or id `0..9`, returns
normal status JSON. Exactly those two fields are required. Bad fields return
400, a wrong/ended/expired session returns 409, and unavailable OLED returns
503. Face requests never renew the drive lease or sequence number. The handler
updates a mailbox; the display task applies the latest selection. Face selection
is volatile, not written to flash. Auto resumes on reboot.

## Build and install

Install Adafruit SSD1306/GFX and dependencies in the configured Arduino CLI
library directory. `scripts/build-firmware.ps1` now includes the local
`libraries/ScoutFaces` library. Build the app using `scripts/build-android.ps1`.
App version: 1.2.0 / code 4. Firmware retains SCOUT 2 / protocol 2 compatibility.

Keep RUN OPEN before ESP USB connection or firmware upload. Unplug ESP USB
before RUN ON. Existing motor reversal preferences are preserved by a normal
upload; no calibration or drive-power mapping was changed. Previous builds are
saved under `artifacts/recovery/Before-Integrated-Faces-2026-10-18`.

## Verification scope

Host regression suites check drive safety, strict face ids, session-gated
selection without lease renewal, rapid taps, stale results, lifecycle cleanup
and animation timing. Firmware/APK builds and device installation results are
recorded in this chat. A real driving/visual check is still an operator test;
USB bench verification uses RUN OPEN and cannot prove wheel motion or radio
range under motor load.

### Completed bench checks, 18 October 2026

- Firmware built: 1,155,407 bytes program flash (88%); 39,424 bytes static RAM.
  Flash uploaded to the ESP32-C3 on COM3 with written hashes verified.
- App 1.2.0/code 4 built, signed and installed on Motorola ZY22CJ2PNG.
  Portrait layout was visually checked: large joystick, horizontal face strip,
  and full Stop button remain visible.
- All 285 firmware checks, 429 Android mixer checks, session/HTTP/datagram/face
  suites, and ScoutFaces timing checks passed. Local HTTP host tests require
  execution outside the restricted sandbox.
- Startup reports ready, OLED ready, Auto selection, zero targets, driver off,
  and both saved motor reverse flags still ON.
- After two initial neutral HTTP setup timeouts during the Android Wi-Fi
  handoff, Connect succeeded. Subsequent face selections and drive checks
  retained the active session without logged link errors.
- Happy, Laughing, Surprised and Auto reached the OLED task from the phone.
  A 24-second serial trace contains 151 status samples, including ten samples
  at +44%/+44% with driver enabled and OLED ready. Stop then returned zero/zero,
  driver disabled, session ended. RUN remained OPEN: this was an electrical/
  software bench check, not a powered-wheel or visual animation measurement.
- Trace and app screenshots: `artifacts/verification/faces-integrated/`.
  Final state: stopped, OLED Auto. Unplug ESP USB before RUN ON.

Download this source file

Scout Faces - SSD1306 128x64 / ESP32-C3

Ten expressions cycle every 5.76 seconds: happy, laughing, surprised,
angry, sad, sleepy, skeptical, winking, cheeky, and dizzy.
Each uses oversized eyes, eyebrows, a small nose, and a mouth.
No border or text takes space from the face. Frames are crisp 1-bit
bitmaps stored in flash (92,160 bytes total), with no image decoding.
Each expression has nine poses: center, two steps left, two steps right,
up, down, half-closed, and closed. Eyes look around and blink twice per
expression. Squinted/spiral eyes move as a unit, preserving their character.
Only changed frames are transferred. Frame timing is 120 ms at 100 kHz.

Wiring: OLED VCC=3V3, GND=GND, SDA=GPIO5, SCL=GPIO7.
The sketch detects 0x3C or 0x3D and holds Scout motor enable GPIO6 LOW.
It is a standalone display demo; Scout phone driving is unavailable.

Open ScoutFaces.ino in Arduino IDE with FaceBitmaps.h beside it.
Install Adafruit SSD1306 plus its dependencies. Select ESP32C3 Dev Module,
USB CDC On Boot Enabled. Keep carrier RUN OPEN and connect ESP USB before
uploading, following the Scout programming procedure. Unplug ESP USB
before RUN ON. Serial Monitor at 115200 reports each expression.

The generator defines the 48-step timeline and ANIMATION_TICK_MS=120.
Change the generator and regenerate FaceBitmaps.h to adjust the animation.
Restore ScoutDrive when you want the regular driving firmware again.
The previous ScoutOledHello test is retained separately.

Artwork source: scripts/build-oled-faces.py. The preview sheet displays
the exact bitmap frames loaded into the sketch, enlarged without smoothing.

// Standalone Scout / ESP32-C3 / SSD1306 128x64 expression demo.
// SDA = GPIO5, SCL = GPIO7, VCC = 3V3, GND = GND.
#include <Arduino.h>
#include <Wire.h>
#include <Adafruit_GFX.h>
#include <Adafruit_SSD1306.h>
#include "FaceBitmaps.h"

// Keep both the transfer and idle bus clocks at 100 kHz.
Adafruit_SSD1306 display(128, 64, &Wire, -1, 100000, 100000);
uint8_t oledAddress = 0;
bool ready = false;

void setup() {
  // Carrier C v10 motor enable is active HIGH. Keep motors disabled.
  digitalWrite(6, LOW);
  pinMode(6, OUTPUT);
  for (uint8_t pin : {0, 1, 3, 10}) {
    digitalWrite(pin, LOW);
    pinMode(pin, OUTPUT);
  }
  Serial.begin(115200);
  delay(2000);
  Serial.println("\nScout Animated OLED Faces: SDA=5, SCL=7");
  if (!Wire.begin(5, 7, 100000)) {
    Serial.println("I2C bus initialization failed. Press RESET to retry.");
    return;
  }
  Wire.setTimeOut(50);
  Serial.println("Scanning I2C addresses...");
  for (uint8_t address = 1; address < 127; ++address) {
    Wire.beginTransmission(address);
    uint8_t error = Wire.endTransmission();
    if (error == 0) {
      Serial.printf("Device acknowledged at 0x%02X\n", address);
      if ((address == 0x3C || address == 0x3D) && oledAddress == 0)
        oledAddress = address;
    } else if (error == 4 || error == 5) {
      Serial.printf("Bus error %u at 0x%02X\n", error, address);
    }
  }
  if (!oledAddress) {
    Serial.println("No OLED at 0x3C or 0x3D. Check 3V3, GND, SDA=5, SCL=7.");
    Serial.println("After correcting wiring, press RESET to scan again.");
    return;
  }
  // periphBegin=false preserves our explicit ESP32-C3 I2C pin assignment.
  if (!display.begin(SSD1306_SWITCHCAPVCC, oledAddress, false, false)) {
    Serial.println("Display buffer allocation failed. Press RESET to retry.");
    return;
  }
  display.clearDisplay();
  display.setTextColor(SSD1306_WHITE);
  display.setTextWrap(false);
  ready = true;
  Serial.printf("OLED commands sent to 0x%02X. Starting ten full-screen expressions.\n", oledAddress);
}

void loop() {
  if (!ready) {
    delay(2000);
    Serial.println("OLED unavailable. Check wiring and press RESET.");
    return;
  }
  // Schedule from elapsed time, rather than adding transfer time to each frame.
  // A 1024-byte frame takes about 100 ms on the proven 100 kHz wiring.
  static uint32_t epoch = millis();
  static int16_t lastFace = -1, lastPose = -1;
  const uint32_t ticks = (millis() - epoch) / ANIMATION_TICK_MS;
  const uint8_t face = (ticks / ANIMATION_TICKS) % FACE_COUNT;
  const uint8_t pose = ANIMATION_POSES[ticks % ANIMATION_TICKS];
  if (face == lastFace && pose == lastPose) {
    delay(2);
    return;
  }
  Wire.beginTransmission(oledAddress);
  if (Wire.endTransmission() != 0) {
    Serial.println("OLED stopped acknowledging. Check wiring and press RESET.");
    ready = false;
    return;
  }
  display.clearDisplay();
  display.drawBitmap(0, 0, FACE_BITMAPS[face][pose], 128, 64, SSD1306_WHITE);
  display.display();
  if (face != lastFace)
    Serial.printf("Face %u/10: %s; OLED 0x%02X\n", face + 1, FACE_NAMES[face], oledAddress);
  Serial.printf("Animation: face=%u pose=%u tick=%u\n", face + 1, pose,
                static_cast<unsigned>(ticks % ANIMATION_TICKS));
  lastFace = face;
  lastPose = pose;
}

Download this source file

Scout OLED Hello World - standalone diagnostic

Wiring: SSD1306 128x64 VCC to 3V3, GND to GND,
SDA to GPIO5, SCL to GPIO7. Match the module's printed labels.

Arduino IDE:
1. Open ScoutOledHello.ino.
2. Install Adafruit SSD1306 using Library Manager, including dependencies.
3. Select ESP32C3 Dev Module and enable USB CDC On Boot.
4. Keep carrier RUN OPEN and connect the ESP USB, as required by the
   existing Scout programming procedure. Choose its COM port and upload.
5. Open Serial Monitor at 115200 baud and press RESET.

Expected: a border, Hello World!, detected address, and an updating
seconds counter. Serial Monitor reports the I2C scan and a heartbeat.
The test selects the first responding device at 0x3C or 0x3D. An address
acknowledgment confirms a device responds, not its controller model or
that pixels are visible. Verify the text on the actual screen.

If no OLED is found: check power, common ground, and SDA/SCL, then RESET.
If an address responds but the screen stays blank: verify the module is
an SSD1306 128x64, check its supply and any reset requirements. This test
assumes a four-pin module with no separate reset connection.

This sketch replaces the running Scout drive program when uploaded;
the phone controls are unavailable during this test. Restore ScoutDrive
after testing. The original ScoutDrive source and output are separate.
No hardware upload is performed by creating or compiling this sketch.

Display API reference:
https://github.com/adafruit/Adafruit_SSD1306

// Standalone Scout / ESP32-C3 / SSD1306 128x64 diagnostic.
// SDA = GPIO5, SCL = GPIO7, VCC = 3V3, GND = GND.
#include <Arduino.h>
#include <Wire.h>
#include <Adafruit_GFX.h>
#include <Adafruit_SSD1306.h>

// Keep both the transfer and idle bus clocks at 100 kHz.
Adafruit_SSD1306 display(128, 64, &Wire, -1, 100000, 100000);
uint8_t oledAddress = 0;
bool ready = false;

void setup() {
  // Carrier C v10 motor enable is active HIGH. Keep motors disabled.
  digitalWrite(6, LOW);
  pinMode(6, OUTPUT);
  for (uint8_t pin : {0, 1, 3, 10}) {
    digitalWrite(pin, LOW);
    pinMode(pin, OUTPUT);
  }
  Serial.begin(115200);
  delay(2000);
  Serial.println("\nScout OLED Hello World: SDA=5, SCL=7");
  if (!Wire.begin(5, 7, 100000)) {
    Serial.println("I2C bus initialization failed. Press RESET to retry.");
    return;
  }
  Wire.setTimeOut(50);
  Serial.println("Scanning I2C addresses...");
  for (uint8_t address = 1; address < 127; ++address) {
    Wire.beginTransmission(address);
    uint8_t error = Wire.endTransmission();
    if (error == 0) {
      Serial.printf("Device acknowledged at 0x%02X\n", address);
      if ((address == 0x3C || address == 0x3D) && oledAddress == 0)
        oledAddress = address;
    } else if (error == 4 || error == 5) {
      Serial.printf("Bus error %u at 0x%02X\n", error, address);
    }
  }
  if (!oledAddress) {
    Serial.println("No OLED at 0x3C or 0x3D. Check 3V3, GND, SDA=5, SCL=7.");
    Serial.println("After correcting wiring, press RESET to scan again.");
    return;
  }
  // periphBegin=false preserves our explicit ESP32-C3 I2C pin assignment.
  if (!display.begin(SSD1306_SWITCHCAPVCC, oledAddress, false, false)) {
    Serial.println("Display buffer allocation failed. Press RESET to retry.");
    return;
  }
  display.clearDisplay();
  display.setTextColor(SSD1306_WHITE);
  display.setTextWrap(false);
  ready = true;
  Serial.printf("OLED commands sent to 0x%02X. Check screen for Hello World.\n", oledAddress);
}

void loop() {
  if (!ready) {
    delay(1000);
    Serial.println("OLED test stopped; see startup diagnostics. Press RESET to retry.");
    return;
  }
  Wire.beginTransmission(oledAddress);
  if (Wire.endTransmission() != 0) {
    Serial.println("OLED stopped acknowledging. Check connections and press RESET.");
    ready = false;
    return;
  }
  display.clearDisplay();
  display.drawRect(0, 0, 128, 64, SSD1306_WHITE);
  display.setTextSize(2);
  display.setCursor(4, 5);
  display.print("Hello");
  display.setCursor(4, 23);
  display.print("World!");
  display.setTextSize(1);
  display.setCursor(4, 44);
  display.printf("I2C 0x%02X  SDA5 SCL7", oledAddress);
  display.setCursor(4, 54);
  display.printf("Seconds: %lu", millis() / 1000UL);
  display.display();
  Serial.printf("OLED responding at 0x%02X; uptime %lu s\n", oledAddress, millis() / 1000UL);
  delay(1000);
}

#include "../ScoutDrive/DriveCore.h"
#include "../ScoutDrive/DriveDatagram.h"
#include "../ScoutDrive/FaceControl.h"
#include "../ScoutDrive/BrowserControl.h"
// Freestanding Windows harness: this machine has MSVC but no Windows SDK/CRT.
extern "C" __declspec(dllimport) void* __stdcall GetStdHandle(unsigned long);
extern "C" __declspec(dllimport) int __stdcall WriteFile(void*, const void*, unsigned long, unsigned long*, void*);
extern "C" __declspec(dllimport) void __stdcall ExitProcess(unsigned int);
static void print(const char* text) { unsigned long n = 0, written = 0; while (text[n]) ++n; WriteFile(GetStdHandle((unsigned long)-11), text, n, &written, nullptr); }
#define TEXT2(value) #value
#define TEXT(value) TEXT2(value)
using namespace scout;
static int checks = 0;
#define CHECK(value) do { ++checks; if (!(value)) { print("FAIL line " TEXT(__LINE__) ": " #value "\n"); ExitProcess(1); } } while (0)
static const char *a = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef";
static const char *b = "fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210";
int main() {
  DriveCore webDrive; webDrive.ready = true;
  BrowserControl browser;
  WebCommand webCommand;
  CHECK(parseWebText(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>("C"), 1, webCommand));
  CHECK(webCommand.action == WebAction::Connect);
  CHECK(parseWebText(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>("F,-1"), 4, webCommand) && webCommand.face == -1);
  CHECK(!parseWebText(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>("F,10"), 4, webCommand));
  CHECK(!parseWebText(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>("C extra"), 7, webCommand));
  CHECK(browser.claim(webDrive, 1, a, 100) == Result::Ok);
  CHECK(browser.owns(webDrive, 1, 101)); CHECK(!browser.owns(webDrive, 2, 101));
  CHECK(webDrive.session(b, 102) == Result::Conflict);
  CHECK(browser.claim(webDrive, 2, b, 102) == Result::Conflict);
  CHECK(!browser.release(webDrive, 2, 103) && webDrive.connected);
  DrivePacket webPacket = {}; webPacket.sequence = 1; webPacket.left = webPacket.right = 44;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 33; ++i) webPacket.token[i] = a[i];
  CHECK(browser.drive(webDrive, 2, webPacket, 110) == Result::Conflict);
  CHECK(browser.drive(webDrive, 1, webPacket, 110) == Result::Ok);
  CHECK(browser.drive(webDrive, 1, webPacket, 111) == Result::Conflict);
  CHECK(webDrive.deadline == 1110);
  CHECK(!browser.owns(webDrive, 1, 1110));
  CHECK(!webDrive.expire(1109));
  CHECK(webDrive.expire(1110));
  CHECK(webDrive.session(b, 1111) == Result::Ok);
  CHECK(webDrive.deadline == 1511); // Android session returns to its 400ms lease
  CHECK(!browser.release(webDrive, 1, 1112)); // stale browser cannot stop Android
  CHECK(webDrive.connected);
  webDrive.stop(1113);
  CHECK(browser.claim(webDrive, 3, a, 1114) == Result::Ok);
  CHECK(browser.release(webDrive, 3, 1115));
  CHECK(!webDrive.connected && webDrive.motors[0].requested == 0);
  int faceId = 42;
  CHECK(parseFaceId("-1", faceId) && faceId == -1);
  CHECK(parseFaceId("9", faceId) && faceId == 9);
  CHECK(!parseFaceId("10", faceId)); CHECK(!parseFaceId("00", faceId));
  CHECK(!parseFaceId("1x", faceId)); CHECK(!parseFaceId("", faceId));
  DriveCore faceDrive; faceDrive.ready = true;
  CHECK(faceDrive.session(a, 100) == Result::Ok);
  FaceControl faceState;
  CHECK(faceState.select(faceDrive, a, 3, 101) == Result::Unavailable);
  faceState.available = true;
  const uint64_t leaseBeforeFace = faceDrive.deadline;
  CHECK(faceState.select(faceDrive, b, 3, 101) == Result::Conflict);
  CHECK(faceState.select(faceDrive, a, 10, 101) == Result::Invalid);
  CHECK(faceState.select(faceDrive, a, 3, 101) == Result::Ok);
  CHECK(faceState.selection == 3 && faceState.generation == 1);
  CHECK(faceDrive.deadline == leaseBeforeFace && faceDrive.sequence == 0);
  CHECK(faceState.select(faceDrive, a, -1, 499) == Result::Ok);
  CHECK(faceState.select(faceDrive, a, 2, 500) == Result::Conflict);
  CHECK(faceState.selection == -1 && faceDrive.deadline == leaseBeforeFace);
  faceDrive.stop(501);
  CHECK(faceState.select(faceDrive, a, 2, 501) == Result::Conflict);
  uint8_t wire[45] = {'S','C','T','2','D'};
  for(unsigned i=0;i<32;++i)wire[5+i]=uint8_t(a[i]);
  write32(wire+37,0xffffffff);write16(wire+41,-44);write16(wire+43,100);
  DrivePacket packet; CHECK(decodeDrive(wire,45,packet));
  CHECK(packet.sequence==UINT32_MAX && packet.left==-44 && packet.right==100 && !packet.stop);
  CHECK(!decodeDrive(wire,44,packet)); wire[3]='1';CHECK(!decodeDrive(wire,45,packet));wire[3]='2';
  write16(wire+41,101);CHECK(!decodeDrive(wire,45,packet));write16(wire+41,0);
  wire[4]='S';write32(wire+37,0);CHECK(decodeDrive(wire,45,packet)&&packet.stop);
  uint8_t ack[50];encodeAck(ack,packet,0,0xfedcba98,3,0,0);
  CHECK(ack[0]=='A'&&ack[3]=='2'&&read32(ack+41)==0xfedcba98&&ack[45]==3);
  // Physical output is zero below useful motor power, including during ramps.
  Motor floor;
  floor.target(30, 0); floor.advance(200); CHECK(floor.pwm == 0);
  floor.target(-39, 201); floor.advance(401); CHECK(floor.pwm == 0);
  floor.target(40, 402); floor.advance(402); CHECK(floor.pwm == 102);
  floor.target(100, 403);
  for (uint64_t t = 403; t <= 603; ++t) { floor.advance(t); CHECK(floor.pwm >= 102 && floor.pwm <= 255); }
  floor.target(30, 604); CHECK(floor.pwm == 0);
  // A startup or failed setup can never create a drive session.
  DriveCore c;
  CHECK(c.session(a, 0) == Result::Unavailable);
  c.ready = true;
  CHECK(c.session(a, 10) == Result::Ok);
  CHECK(c.connected && c.deadline == 410 && !c.canEnable(10));
  CHECK(c.session(b, 11) == Result::Conflict);
  CHECK(c.drive(a, 1, 60, -30, 20) == Result::Ok);
  c.advance(220);
  CHECK(c.motors[0].pwm == 153 && c.motors[1].pwm == 0);
  CHECK(c.canEnable(220));
  // Invalid pairs and replayed/foreign commands neither change targets nor renew.
  CHECK(c.drive(a, 2, 40, 101, 221) == Result::Invalid);
  CHECK(c.motors[0].requested == 60 && c.motors[1].requested == 0 && c.deadline == 420);
  CHECK(c.drive(b, 2, 0, 0, 222) == Result::Conflict);
  CHECK(c.drive(a, 1, 0, 0, 223) == Result::Conflict);
  CHECK(c.deadline == 420);
  // Lease expires at the exact boundary and cannot be resurrected by a late packet.
  CHECK(!c.expire(419));
  CHECK(c.expire(420));
  CHECK(!c.connected && !c.canEnable(420) && c.motors[0].pwm == 0 && c.motors[1].requested == 0);
  CHECK(c.drive(a, 2, 60, 60, 421) == Result::Conflict);
  CHECK(c.session(b, 422) == Result::Ok);
  CHECK(c.drive(a, 3, 60, 60, 423) == Result::Conflict);
  CHECK(c.drive(b, UINT32_MAX, 50, 50, 424) == Result::Ok);
  CHECK(c.drive(b, 0, 50, 50, 425) == Result::Conflict);
  c.stop(426);
  CHECK(c.drive(b, UINT32_MAX, 50, 50, 427) == Result::Conflict);
  // If the timer task is delayed, request validation still enforces expiry itself.
  CHECK(c.session(a, 1000) == Result::Ok);
  CHECK(c.drive(a, 1, 1, 1, 1400) == Result::Conflict);
  CHECK(!c.connected);
  // Reversal cuts immediately, repeats cannot restart the dead time or bypass it.
  Motor m;
  m.target(100, 0); m.advance(200); CHECK(m.pwm == 255);
  m.target(-100, 201); CHECK(m.pwm == 0);
  m.target(-100, 251); m.advance(300); CHECK(m.pwm == 0);
  m.advance(301); CHECK(m.pwm == -102);
  m.advance(401); CHECK(m.pwm == -179);
  m.advance(501); CHECK(m.pwm == -255);
  // Zero followed by reverse still must provide a full all-low interval.
  m.target(0, 502); CHECK(m.pwm == 0);
  m.target(100, 503); m.target(0, 520); m.target(100, 521);
  m.advance(601); CHECK(m.pwm == 0);
  m.advance(702); CHECK(m.pwm == 179);
  m.advance(802); CHECK(m.pwm == 255);
  // Reversing back while pending cannot cancel the established off interval.
  m.target(-100, 803); m.target(100, 810); m.advance(902); CHECK(m.pwm == 0);
  m.advance(1003); CHECK(m.pwm == 179);
  // Session/global stop preserves electrical reversal history for an immediate reconnect.
  m.advance(1103); CHECK(m.pwm == 255);
  m.stop(1104); m.target(-100, 1105); m.advance(1203); CHECK(m.pwm == 0);
  m.advance(1304); CHECK(m.pwm == -179);
  // Same-target refresh cannot indefinitely prevent acceleration.
  Motor repeating;
  repeating.target(100, 0); repeating.target(100, 50); repeating.target(100, 100);
  repeating.target(100, 150); repeating.advance(200); CHECK(repeating.pwm == 255);
  // Both zero is immediate, even in the middle of a ramp.
  CHECK(c.session(b, 2000) == Result::Ok);
  CHECK(c.drive(b, 1, 100, -100, 2001) == Result::Ok);
  c.advance(2101); CHECK(c.canEnable(2101));
  CHECK(c.drive(b, 2, 0, 0, 2102) == Result::Ok);
  CHECK(!c.canEnable(2102) && c.motors[0].pwm == 0 && c.motors[1].pwm == 0);
  CHECK(c.drive(b, 3, 100, 100, 2200) == Result::Ok);
  c.advance(2402); CHECK(c.motors[0].pwm == 255 && c.motors[1].pwm == 255);
  CHECK(c.drive(b, 4, 0, 100, 2403) == Result::Ok);
  CHECK(c.motors[0].pwm == 0 && c.motors[1].pwm == 255 && c.canEnable(2403));
  // Strict field parsing rejects overflow, missing, fractional and junk fields.
  uint32_t seq = 99; int percent = 99;
  CHECK(parseSequence("4294967295", seq) && seq == UINT32_MAX);
  CHECK(!parseSequence("4294967296", seq));
  CHECK(!parseSequence("-1", seq) && !parseSequence("1x", seq) && !parseSequence("", seq));
  CHECK(parsePercent("-100", percent) && percent == -100);
  CHECK(parsePercent("0", percent) && percent == 0);
  CHECK(!parsePercent("101", percent) && !parsePercent("-101", percent));
  CHECK(!parsePercent("1.5", percent) && !parsePercent("+1", percent) && !parsePercent(" 1", percent));
  print("Firmware core: all tests passed; ");
  char digits[12]; unsigned pos = 11; digits[pos] = 0; int n = checks;
  do { digits[--pos] = static_cast<char>('0' + n % 10); n /= 10; } while (n);
  print(digits + pos); print(" checks\n"); ExitProcess(0);
}

#include "ScoutFaces.h"
extern "C" __declspec(dllimport) void __stdcall ExitProcess(unsigned int);
#define CHECK(x) do { if (!(x)) ExitProcess(__LINE__); } while (0)
extern "C" int main() {
  using E = ScoutFaces::Expression;
  using P = ScoutFaces::Pose;
  Adafruit_GFX display(128, 64);
  ScoutFaces faces(display);
  CHECK(!faces.update(0));
  CHECK(faces.begin(0));
  CHECK(faces.update(0));
  CHECK(!faces.update(119));
  CHECK(!faces.update(120));
  CHECK(faces.update(600));
  CHECK(faces.pose() == P::LeftHalf);
  CHECK(faces.update(720));
  CHECK(faces.pose() == P::Left);
  CHECK(faces.update(2160));
  CHECK(faces.pose() == P::Closed);
  CHECK(faces.update(2280));
  CHECK(faces.pose() == P::HalfClosed);
  CHECK(faces.update(2400));
  CHECK(faces.pose() == P::Center);
  for (uint32_t n = 1; n <= 10; ++n) {
    CHECK(faces.update(n * 5760));
    CHECK(static_cast<uint8_t>(faces.expression()) == n % 10);
  }
  faces.setExpression(E::Cheeky, 60000);
  CHECK(!faces.autoCycle());
  CHECK(faces.update(60000));
  CHECK(faces.update(60000+2160));
  CHECK(faces.pose() == P::Closed);
  faces.update(60000+5760*20);
  CHECK(faces.expression() == E::Cheeky);
  faces.setAutoCycle(true, 200000);
  CHECK(faces.update(200000+5760*3));
  CHECK(faces.expression() == E::Laughing);
  faces.setExpression(static_cast<E>(255), 0);
  CHECK(faces.expression() == E::Laughing);
  CHECK(ScoutFaces::name(static_cast<E>(255))[0] == 'U');
  // Unsigned elapsed arithmetic must preserve the timeline over millis wrap.
  CHECK(faces.begin(0xFFFFFF00u));
  CHECK(faces.update(0xFFFFFF00u));
  CHECK(faces.update(0xFFFFFF00u+720u));
  CHECK(faces.pose() == P::Left);
  faces.setFrameInterval(0, 1000); // clamps to 20 ms
  faces.update(1000);
  CHECK(faces.update(1100));
  CHECK(faces.pose() == P::LeftHalf);
  Adafruit_GFX wrong(64,128);
  ScoutFaces invalid(wrong);
  CHECK(!invalid.begin());
  CHECK(!invalid.update(500));
  ExitProcess(0);
}

const {test} = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const {mix, encodeDrive, DriveLink} = require('../web/control-core.js');
const token = '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef';
const reply = (ack, extra={}) => ({ack, boot:7, ready:true, connected:true, ...extra});
test('mixer preserves Scout mapping, steering and bounded symmetry', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(mix(1,0,35),[44,44]);
  assert.deepEqual(mix(1,0,30),[0,0]);
  assert.deepEqual(mix(0,1,100),[-100,100]);
  assert.deepEqual(mix(NaN,0,100),[0,0]);
  for (let cap=0; cap<=100; cap++) for (const [f,t] of [[1,0],[0,1],[1,1],[.5,-.7]]) {
    const a=mix(f,t,cap), b=f===0 ? mix(0,-t,cap) : mix(-f,t,cap);
    for(let i=0;i<2;i++) {
      assert.ok(Math.abs(a[i])<=100);
      assert.ok(a[i]===0 || Math.abs(a[i])>=40);
      assert.equal(a[i]+b[i],0);
    }
  }
});
test('reverse arcs follow steering while forward arcs and stationary turns stay unchanged', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(mix(1,1,35),[0,44]);
  assert.deepEqual(mix(1,-1,35),[44,0]);
  assert.deepEqual(mix(-1,1,35),[0,-44]);
  assert.deepEqual(mix(-1,-1,35),[-44,0]);
  assert.deepEqual(mix(-1,0,35),[-44,-44]);
  assert.deepEqual(mix(0,1,35),[-44,44]);
  assert.deepEqual(mix(0,-1,35),[44,-44]);
});
test('binary frame matches protocol 2 byte order and signed targets', () => {
  const frame=encodeDrive(token,0xfedcba98,-44,100);
  assert.equal(frame.byteLength,45);
  const bytes=new Uint8Array(frame), view=new DataView(frame);
  assert.equal(String.fromCharCode(...bytes.slice(0,5)),'SCT2D');
  assert.equal(view.getUint32(37),0xfedcba98);
  assert.equal(view.getInt16(41),-44); assert.equal(view.getInt16(43),100);
});
test('continuous updates, release acknowledgement gate and neutral reconnect', () => {
  const link=new DriveLink(); link.begin(token,7,0); link.input(1,0);
  assert.ok(link.next(50,50,true)); assert.equal(link.pending,1);
  assert.ok(link.next(150,150,true));
  const zero=new DataView(link.release(160)); assert.equal(zero.getInt16(41),0);
  link.input(1,0); assert.deepEqual(link.target,[0,0]);
  link.ack(reply(2),170); assert.equal(link.releasePending,true);
  assert.ok(link.next(260,260,true));
  link.ack(reply(3),270); assert.equal(link.releasePending,false);
  link.input(1,0); assert.deepEqual(link.target,[44,44]);
  link.end(); link.begin(token,8,1000); assert.deepEqual(link.target,[0,0]);
});
test('UI stalls, hidden page, missing ack, boot change and expiry stop control', () => {
  for (const run of [
    l=>l.next(300,0,true), l=>l.next(50,50,false),
    l=>{l.next(50,50,true);l.next(800,800,true);},
    l=>{l.next(50,50,true);l.ack(reply(1,{boot:8}),60);},
    l=>{l.next(50,50,true);l.ack(reply(1,{connected:false}),60);}
  ]) { const l=new DriveLink();l.begin(token,7,0);assert.throws(()=>run(l)); }
});

test('600ms reply latency does not stall the 100ms command stream', () => {
  const l=new DriveLink();l.begin(token,7,0);l.input(1,0);
  for(let now=0;now<=2000;now+=100){
    if(now>=600) l.ack(reply((now-600)/100+1),now);
    const frame=l.next(now,now,true);
    assert.ok(frame,'drive stream stalled at '+now);
    assert.equal(new DataView(frame).getInt16(41),44);
  }
});

test('duplicate, future and stale acknowledgements cannot renew reply freshness', () => {
  const l=new DriveLink();l.begin(token,7,0);l.next(0,0,true);
  l.ack(reply(1),100);l.ack(reply(1),350);l.ack(reply(100),350);
  assert.throws(()=>l.next(900,900,true),/replies delayed/);
  const stale=new DriveLink();stale.begin(token,7,0);stale.next(0,0,true);
  stale.ack(reply(1),801);
  assert.throws(()=>stale.next(801,801,true),/replies delayed/);
});

test('periodic updates are 100ms apart and reply cutoff is exactly 800ms',()=>{
  const l=new DriveLink();l.begin(token,7,0);
  assert.ok(l.next(0,0,true));assert.equal(l.next(99,99,true),null);
  assert.ok(l.next(100,100,true));assert.ok(l.next(799,799,true));
  assert.throws(()=>l.next(800,800,true),/replies delayed/);
});

const {test}=require('node:test');
const assert=require('node:assert/strict');
const fs=require('node:fs'),vm=require('node:vm'),path=require('node:path');
const ScoutControl=require('../web/control-core.js');
function app(){
  const nodes=new Map(),listeners={};
  function element(){return {textContent:'',style:{},dataset:{},value:'35',tagName:'DIV',classList:{toggle(){}},setAttribute(){},append(){},setPointerCapture(){},getBoundingClientRect(){return {left:0,top:0,width:200,height:200};}};}
  const node=id=>{if(!nodes.has(id))nodes.set(id,element());return nodes.get(id);};
  let ws;
  class Socket{
    static OPEN=1;static CONNECTING=0;
    constructor(){ws=this;this.readyState=1;this.bufferedAmount=0;this.sent=[];}
    send(data){this.sent.push(data);}close(){this.closed=true;}
  }
  const context={ScoutControl,WebSocket:Socket,performance:{now:()=>100},document:{getElementById:node,createElement:element,hidden:false,hasFocus:()=>true,addEventListener(n,f){listeners[n]=f;}},window:{addEventListener(n,f){listeners[n]=f;}},location:{hostname:'192.168.4.1'},requestAnimationFrame(){},setTimeout(){},clearTimeout(){},setInterval(f){this.tick=f;}};
  vm.runInNewContext(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'../web/control-app.js'),'utf8'),context);
  node('connect').onclick();
  ws.onmessage({data:JSON.stringify({protocol:2,timeoutMs:400,browserTimeoutMs:1000,boot:7,ready:true,connected:true,oledReady:true,enabled:false,left:0,right:0,token:'0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef'})});
  node('pad').onpointerdown({pointerId:1,button:0,clientX:100,clientY:10,preventDefault(){}});
  return {node,ws};
}
for(const action of ['speed','focus away from joystick'])test(`${action}: one buffered drive frame must allow an immediate zero without disconnect`,()=>{
  const {node,ws}=app();ws.bufferedAmount=45;
  if(action==='speed'){node('limit').value='60';node('limit').oninput();}else node('pad').onblur();
  assert.ok(!ws.closed,'ordinary buffered drive frame incorrectly closes the session');
  const zero=ws.sent.find(x=>x instanceof ArrayBuffer);
  assert.ok(zero,'release must send a zero frame');
  assert.equal(new DataView(zero).getInt16(41),0);
  assert.equal(new DataView(zero).getInt16(43),0);
});
test('release still disconnects when the transport backlog exceeds its bounded limit',()=>{
  const {node,ws}=app();ws.bufferedAmount=300;node('limit').oninput();assert.equal(ws.closed,true);
  assert.match(node('message').textContent,/send queue stalled.*300 bytes/);
});

test('closed transport reports a different cause from a stalled send queue',()=>{
  const {node,ws}=app();ws.readyState=3;node('limit').oninput();
  assert.equal(ws.closed,true);
  assert.match(node('message').textContent,/connection closed/);
});

'use strict';
(() => {
  const $=id=>document.getElementById(id), link=new ScoutControl.DriveLink();
  const names=['Happy','Laughing','Surprised','Angry','Sad','Sleepy','Skeptical','Winking','Cheeky','Dizzy'];
  let socket=null, waiting=false, saving=false, ready=false, oled=false, pointer=null, renderAt=performance.now(), claimTimer;
  const faceButtons=[];
  function text(id,value){$(id).textContent=value;}
  function knob(x=0,y=0){$('knob').style.transform=`translate(-50%,-50%) translate(${x}px,${y}px)`;}
  function paint(){
    $('connect').disabled=link.active||waiting||saving;
    $('saveDirections').disabled=link.active||waiting||saving||!ready;
    $('reverseLeft').disabled=$('reverseRight').disabled=link.active||waiting||saving;
    $('pad').classList.toggle('enabled',link.active);
    for(const button of faceButtons) button.disabled=!link.active||!oled;
    text('state',link.active?'● Connected':waiting?'◌ Connecting…':'○ Disconnected');
  }
  function stop(reason,send=true){
    const owned=link.active;
    link.end();waiting=false;clearTimeout(claimTimer);pointer=null;knob();
    text('left','L 0%');text('right','R 0%');text('message',reason);
    text('faceStatus','Connect to choose · swipe for more');
    for(const button of faceButtons)button.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');
    if(socket){const old=socket;socket=null;
      if(send&&owned&&old.readyState===WebSocket.OPEN)try{old.send('S');}catch(_){}
      old.close();
    }
    paint();
  }
  function status(j){
    ready=j.ready===true;oled=j.oledReady===true;
    if(typeof j.leftReversed==='boolean')$('reverseLeft').checked=j.leftReversed;
    if(typeof j.rightReversed==='boolean')$('reverseRight').checked=j.rightReversed;
    if(link.active){
      text('left',`L ${j.left>0?'+':''}${j.left||0}%`);text('right',`R ${j.right>0?'+':''}${j.right||0}%`);
      text('faceStatus',oled?(j.face===-1?'Auto · all ten':names[j.face]||'Face ready'):'OLED unavailable');
      for(const b of faceButtons)b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(Number(b.dataset.id)===j.face));
    }
    paint();
  }
  function claim(){
    if(!waiting||!socket||socket.readyState!==WebSocket.OPEN)return;
    socket.send('C');clearTimeout(claimTimer);
    claimTimer=setTimeout(()=>stop('Connection not confirmed · try Connect again'),1800);
  }
  function open(){
    const ws=new WebSocket(`ws://${location.hostname}:81/`,'arduino');socket=ws;
    ws.onopen=()=>{if(socket===ws&&waiting)claim();};
    ws.onmessage=event=>{
      if(socket!==ws)return;
      try{
        if(typeof event.data!=='string'||event.data.length>4096)throw Error('Invalid Scout response');
        const j=JSON.parse(event.data);
        if(j.error)throw Error(j.error);
        if(j.protocol!==2||j.timeoutMs!==400||j.browserTimeoutMs!==1000||!Number.isInteger(j.boot))throw Error('Firmware update needed');
        if(j.token){
          if(!waiting||!j.connected||!j.ready||j.enabled||j.left||j.right)throw Error('Neutral session not confirmed');
          link.begin(j.token,j.boot,performance.now());waiting=false;clearTimeout(claimTimer);
          text('message','Connected · touch to drive');
        }else if(link.active){
          if(j.boot!==link.boot||!j.ready||!j.connected)throw Error('Scout session ended · reconnect');
          if(j.ack)link.ack(j,performance.now());
        }else if(!waiting){text('message',j.connected?'Scout already has a controller. Stop it before connecting.':'Ready when you are');}
        status(j);
      }catch(error){stop(error.message);}
    };
    ws.onerror=()=>{if(socket===ws)stop('Scout link unavailable · check Wi-Fi');};
    ws.onclose=()=>{if(socket===ws)stop('Scout disconnected · reconnect to drive',false);};
  }
  $('connect').onclick=()=>{
    if(link.active||waiting||saving||document.hidden)return;
    waiting=true;text('message','Creating a stopped control session…');paint();
    if(socket&&socket.readyState===WebSocket.OPEN)claim();
    else if(!socket||socket.readyState!==WebSocket.CONNECTING)open();
    clearTimeout(claimTimer);claimTimer=setTimeout(()=>stop('No response · join C3-Scout-Test and retry'),4000);
  };
  $('stop').onclick=()=>stop('Stopped · reconnect to drive');
  function send(frame){
    if(!socket||socket.readyState!==WebSocket.OPEN)throw Error('Scout connection closed · reconnect');
    if(socket.bufferedAmount>256)throw Error(`Scout send queue stalled (${socket.bufferedAmount} bytes) · reconnect`);
    socket.send(frame);
  }
  function release(){
    if(pointer===null)return;
    pointer=null;knob();
    try{
      // A normal drive frame may still be buffered when a setting takes focus.
      // Queue its immediate zero through send()'s bounded backlog check.
      const frame=link.release(performance.now());if(frame)send(frame);
    }catch(error){stop(error.message);}
  }
  function move(event){
    if(event.pointerId!==pointer)return;
    const r=$('pad').getBoundingClientRect(),radius=r.width*.4;
    let x=(event.clientX-r.left-r.width/2)/radius,y=(event.clientY-r.top-r.height/2)/radius;
    const scale=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(x,y));x/=scale;y/=scale;
    link.input(-y,x);knob(x*radius,y*radius);
  }
  $('pad').onpointerdown=event=>{
    if(!link.active||link.releasePending||pointer!==null||event.button>0)return;
    event.preventDefault();pointer=event.pointerId;$('pad').setPointerCapture(pointer);move(event);
  };
  $('pad').onpointermove=move;
  $('pad').onpointerup=$('pad').onpointercancel=$('pad').onlostpointercapture=event=>{if(event.pointerId===pointer)release();};
  const keys=new Set();
  $('pad').onkeydown=e=>{
    if(!['ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight'].includes(e.key)||!link.active||link.releasePending)return;
    e.preventDefault();keys.add(e.key);pointer='keys';
    const f=Number(keys.has('ArrowUp'))-Number(keys.has('ArrowDown'));
    const t=Number(keys.has('ArrowRight'))-Number(keys.has('ArrowLeft'));
    link.input(f,t);const r=$('pad').clientWidth*.3;knob(t*r,-f*r);
  };
  $('pad').onkeyup=e=>{if(keys.has(e.key)){keys.clear();release();}};
  $('pad').onblur=()=>{keys.clear();release();};
  $('limit').oninput=()=>{release();link.cap=Number($('limit').value);text('limitValue',`${link.cap}%`);};
  for(let id=-1;id<names.length;id++){
    const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.dataset.id=String(id);
    b.textContent=id<0?'Auto':names[id];b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');
    b.onclick=()=>{if(link.active&&oled)try{send(`F,${id}`);}catch(e){stop(e.message);}};
    $('faces').append(b);faceButtons.push(b);
  }
  $('saveDirections').onclick=async()=>{
    if(link.active||waiting||saving)return;
    saving=true;paint();text('configStatus','Saving…');
    const abort=new AbortController(),timer=setTimeout(()=>abort.abort(),1800);
    try{
      const body=`leftReversed=${Number($('reverseLeft').checked)}&rightReversed=${Number($('reverseRight').checked)}`;
      const response=await fetch('/config',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},body,signal:abort.signal});
      const j=await response.json();if(!response.ok||!j.ready||j.connected)throw Error(j.message||'Directions not confirmed');
      status(j);text('configStatus','Directions saved on Scout');
    }catch(e){text('configStatus',e.name==='AbortError'?'Save not confirmed · check connection':e.message);}
    finally{clearTimeout(timer);saving=false;paint();}
  };
  function render(now){renderAt=now;requestAnimationFrame(render);}requestAnimationFrame(render);
  setInterval(()=>{try{const frame=link.next(performance.now(),renderAt,!document.hidden&&document.hasFocus());if(frame)send(frame);}catch(e){stop(e.message);}},100);
  for(const name of ['blur','pagehide'])window.addEventListener(name,()=>{if(link.active||waiting)stop('Page left · reconnect to drive');});
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden&&(link.active||waiting))stop('Page hidden · reconnect to drive');});
  window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.code==='Space'&&e.target.tagName!=='INPUT'){e.preventDefault();stop('Stopped · reconnect to drive');}});
  paint();open();
})();

'use strict';
const ScoutControl = (() => {
  const UPDATE_MS=100, REPLY_TIMEOUT_MS=800;
  function mix(forward, turn, cap) {
    if (![forward, turn, cap].every(Number.isFinite)) return [0, 0];
    const radius = Math.hypot(forward, turn);
    if (radius <= .08) return [0, 0];
    const gain = (Math.min(1, radius) - .08) / .92 / radius;
    // Reverse steering with travel direction; keep stationary turns unchanged.
    const steering = forward < 0 ? -turn : turn;
    const left = (forward - steering) * gain, right = (forward + steering) * gain;
    const scale = Math.max(1, Math.abs(left), Math.abs(right));
    const limit = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, cap));
    return [left, right].map(v => {
      const command = Math.round(v / scale * limit), n = Math.abs(command);
      return n <= 30 ? 0 : Math.sign(command) * (40 + Math.floor((Math.min(100,n)-30)*60/70));
    });
  }
  function encodeDrive(token, sequence, left, right) {
    if (!/^[0-9a-f]{32}$/.test(token) || !Number.isInteger(sequence) || sequence < 1 || sequence > 0xffffffff ||
        ![left,right].every(n=>Number.isInteger(n) && Math.abs(n)<=100)) throw Error('Invalid drive command');
    const frame = new ArrayBuffer(45), bytes = new Uint8Array(frame), view = new DataView(frame);
    for (let i=0;i<5;i++) bytes[i]='SCT2D'.charCodeAt(i);
    for (let i=0;i<32;i++) bytes[5+i]=token.charCodeAt(i);
    view.setUint32(37,sequence); view.setInt16(41,left); view.setInt16(43,right);
    return frame;
  }
  class DriveLink {
    constructor() { this.cap=35; this.end(); }
    end() { this.active=false;this.token=null;this.target=[0,0];this.pending=0;this.releasePending=false;this.releaseSequence=0;this.acked=0;this.inflight=new Map(); }
    begin(token, boot, now) {
      encodeDrive(token,1,0,0);
      this.end();this.active=true;this.token=token;this.boot=boot;this.sequence=0;
      this.lastAck=now;this.lastSend=now-UPDATE_MS;this.sentAt=now;
    }
    input(forward,turn) { if(this.active && !this.releasePending) this.target=mix(forward,turn,this.cap); }
    packet(now, pair) {
      if(this.sequence>=0xffffffff) throw Error('Session complete · reconnect');
      const frame=encodeDrive(this.token,++this.sequence,...pair);
      for(const [seq,at] of this.inflight) if(now-at>=REPLY_TIMEOUT_MS)this.inflight.delete(seq);
      this.inflight.set(this.sequence,now);
      this.pending=this.sequence;this.sentAt=this.lastSend=now;
      return frame;
    }
    release(now) {
      this.target=[0,0]; if(!this.active) return null;
      this.releasePending=true;
      const frame=this.packet(now,this.target);
      this.releaseSequence=this.sequence;
      return frame;
    }
    next(now, renderAt, foreground) {
      if(!this.active) return null;
      if(!foreground || now-renderAt>250) throw Error('Page paused · reconnect to drive');
      if(now-this.lastAck>=REPLY_TIMEOUT_MS) throw Error('Scout replies delayed · reconnect');
      // Keep fresh commands flowing while earlier replies are in transit.
      // send() separately bounds unsent bytes; the ESP retains its 1000ms browser lease.
      if(now-this.lastSend<UPDATE_MS) return null;
      return this.packet(now,this.target);
    }
    ack(reply, now) {
      if(!this.active) return;
      if(reply.boot!==this.boot || !reply.ready || !reply.connected) throw Error('Scout session ended · reconnect');
      const sent=this.inflight.get(reply.ack);
      if(Number.isInteger(reply.ack)&&reply.ack>this.acked&&sent!==undefined&&now-sent<REPLY_TIMEOUT_MS&&now-this.lastAck<REPLY_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        this.acked=reply.ack;this.lastAck=now;
        for(const [seq] of this.inflight)if(seq<=this.acked)this.inflight.delete(seq);
        if(this.acked===this.pending)this.pending=0;
        if(this.releasePending&&this.acked>=this.releaseSequence)this.releasePending=false;
      }
    }
  }
  return {mix,encodeDrive,DriveLink};
})();
if(typeof module!=='undefined') module.exports=ScoutControl;

#include <Wire.h>
#include <Adafruit_SSD1306.h>
#include <ScoutFaces.h>

constexpr int SDA_PIN = 5, SCL_PIN = 7; // Change for your board.
Adafruit_SSD1306 display(128, 64, &Wire, -1, 100000, 100000);
ScoutFaces faces(display);

void setup() {
  Serial.begin(115200);
  // Scout Carrier C v10 only: keep motor driver disabled during the demo.
  // Omit this GPIO6 assignment on other boards if the pin has another use.
  digitalWrite(6, LOW);
  pinMode(6, OUTPUT);
  delay(500);
  if (!Wire.begin(SDA_PIN, SCL_PIN, 100000)) while (true) delay(1000);
  Wire.setTimeOut(50);
  uint8_t address = 0;
  for (uint8_t candidate : {0x3C, 0x3D}) {
    Wire.beginTransmission(candidate);
    if (Wire.endTransmission() == 0) { address = candidate; break; }
  }
  if (!address) {
    Serial.println("No OLED at 0x3C/0x3D. Check wiring and reset.");
    while (true) delay(1000);
  }
  if (!display.begin(SSD1306_SWITCHCAPVCC, address, false, false) || !faces.begin()) {
    Serial.println("Display initialization failed. Requires 128x64 landscape.");
    while (true) delay(1000);
  }
}

void loop() {
  if (faces.update()) display.display();
  // Other project work goes here; no animation delay() is required.
}

#include <Wire.h>
#include <Adafruit_SSD1306.h>
#include <ScoutFaces.h>

Adafruit_SSD1306 display(128, 64, &Wire, -1, 100000, 100000);
ScoutFaces faces(display);

void setup() {
  // Scout-specific motor disable. Remove on other boards as appropriate.
  digitalWrite(6, LOW);
  pinMode(6, OUTPUT);
  Wire.begin(5, 7, 100000); // Set your board's SDA and SCL here.
  // Change 0x3C to 0x3D if that is your display's address.
  if (!display.begin(SSD1306_SWITCHCAPVCC, 0x3C, false, false) || !faces.begin())
    while (true) delay(1000);
  faces.setExpression(ScoutFaces::Expression::Cheeky);
}

void loop() {
  if (faces.update()) display.display();
  // In your own event handler you can select a different face:
  // faces.setExpression(ScoutFaces::Expression::Surprised);
  // Or resume all ten expressions: faces.setAutoCycle(true);
}

libraries/ScoutFaces/README.md

Download this source file

# ScoutFaces 1.0.0

Ten expressive, animated faces for a **128×64 monochrome OLED**: Happy,
Laughing, Surprised, Angry, Sad, Sleepy, Skeptical, Winking, Cheeky and Dizzy.
Eyes blink and glance left, right, up and down. Each auto-cycled expression
lasts 5.76 seconds at the default timing.

## Install

In Arduino IDE choose **Sketch → Include Library → Add .ZIP Library…** and
select `ScoutFaces-1.0.0.zip`. Install **Adafruit SSD1306** and **Adafruit GFX
Library** with dependencies through Library Manager. Open **File → Examples
→ ScoutFaces → AutoCycle** or **SelectExpression**.

Tested toolchain: ESP32-C3, Arduino ESP32 3.3.12, Adafruit SSD1306 2.5.17,
Adafruit GFX 1.12.6. Other boards must have enough flash and a compatible GFX
framebuffer; the bitmap artwork alone occupies 92,160 bytes. Classic Uno/Nano
ATmega328P boards cannot hold this library. Other boards/drivers are not bench
verified. The example pin setup uses ESP32's Wire.begin(SDA,SCL,frequency);
adapt it to your board's Wire API.

## Minimal integration

Initialize your 128×64 display using its normal driver first, then:

```cpp
#include <ScoutFaces.h>
ScoutFaces faces(display);  // display is your existing Adafruit_GFX object

// After display.begin(...) in setup():
// if (!faces.begin()) { /* wrong display dimensions */ }

// In loop():
// if (faces.update()) display.display();
```

See the complete examples for runnable sketches. `update()` draws only when a
pose changes and returns true when the framebuffer needs flushing. It has no
delay, Serial, Wire, pin, motor or display-initialization calls. The framebuffer
flush (`display.display()`) still takes bus time: about 100 ms at 100 kHz for
an SSD1306. Do not place it in a hard real-time motor-control path. The faces
own the whole framebuffer and clear it on each changed frame.

## API

| Call | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `ScoutFaces faces(display)` | Bind an existing GFX display by reference; keep it alive |
| `faces.begin()` | Check for 128×64 landscape dimensions, start timeline; false if incompatible |
| `faces.update()` | Draw changed pose, true when caller must flush; false before begin or if unchanged |
| `faces.setExpression(ScoutFaces::Expression::Happy)` | Select one face, reset animation, turn auto-cycle off; blinks/glances continue |
| `faces.setAutoCycle(true)` | Restart timeline and resume cycling from current expression |
| `faces.setAutoCycle(false)` | Hold current expression with eye animation; restart timeline |
| `faces.setFrameInterval(120)` | Set milliseconds per tick, minimum 20; expression duration is 48 ticks |
| `faces.expression()` / `faces.pose()` | Current rendered expression and pose, updated by update() |
| `faces.autoCycle()` | Whether automatic expression cycling is enabled |
| `ScoutFaces::name(expression)` | Expression name; invalid enum returns "Unknown" |
| `ScoutFaces::expressionCount()` | 10 |

Timing methods accept an optional final `uint32_t now` argument for an external
millisecond clock. Defaults use `millis()`. All calls must use the same clock.
Unsigned elapsed-time arithmetic handles a normal millis rollover. If loop
work is late, update skips to the current pose rather than replaying a backlog.
Call regularly; gaps of a full 32-bit clock period cannot be distinguished.
The default 120 ms is suited to the tested 100 kHz bus. Faster intervals need
a faster compatible bus; requesting 20 ms does not make a 100 ms transfer faster.

Expressions: `Happy`, `Laughing`, `Surprised`, `Angry`, `Sad`, `Sleepy`,
`Skeptical`, `Winking`, `Cheeky`, `Dizzy`.

Poses: `Center`, `LeftHalf`, `Left`, `RightHalf`, `Right`, `Up`, `Down`,
`HalfClosed`, `Closed`. Laughing and sleepy eyes retain their squint; spiral
eyes move as a unit. A wink retains its closed eye.

## Scout wiring and troubleshooting

SSD1306 VCC → 3V3, GND → GND, SDA → GPIO5, SCL → GPIO7. Actual Scout
display responds at 0x3C; AutoCycle tries 0x3C and 0x3D. Enable USB CDC On Boot
for ESP32-C3 Serial output. Carrier RUN must be OPEN before connecting ESP USB;
unplug ESP USB before RUN ON. The examples hold Scout GPIO6 motor enable LOW;
remove that Scout-specific assignment in other projects if GPIO6 has another use.

A blank display: check address, power, wiring and SSD1306 128×64 controller.
If update returns true but nothing appears, call your driver's display/flush
method. begin() checks geometry, not wiring or controller identity. It does not
detect an unplugged display. Ensure only one copy of ScoutFaces is installed.

The original animated demo was flashed and its complete cycle observed over
USB on Scout. The reusable library is compiled with both examples and has host
timeline tests; see the project verification notes for hardware checks. Installing
the library does not change Scout's firmware. This package contains only the
face code/artwork and examples; install Adafruit dependencies separately.

#include "ScoutFaces.h"
#include "FaceBitmaps.h"

ScoutFaces::ScoutFaces(Adafruit_GFX& display) : display_(display) {}

void ScoutFaces::restart(uint32_t now) {
  lastTick_ = now;
  tick_ = 0;
  pose_ = Pose::Center;
  dirty_ = true;
}

bool ScoutFaces::begin(uint32_t now) {
  ready_ = display_.width() == 128 && display_.height() == 64;
  restart(now);
  return ready_;
}

void ScoutFaces::setExpression(Expression expression, uint32_t now) {
  if (static_cast<uint8_t>(expression) >= FACE_COUNT) return;
  expression_ = expression;
  autoCycle_ = false;
  restart(now);
}

void ScoutFaces::setAutoCycle(bool enabled, uint32_t now) {
  autoCycle_ = enabled;
  restart(now);
}

void ScoutFaces::setFrameInterval(uint16_t milliseconds, uint32_t now) {
  frameMs_ = milliseconds < 20 ? 20 : milliseconds;
  restart(now);
}

const char* ScoutFaces::name(Expression expression) {
  const auto index = static_cast<uint8_t>(expression);
  return index < FACE_COUNT ? FACE_NAMES[index] : "Unknown";
}

bool ScoutFaces::update(uint32_t now) {
  if (!ready_) return false;
  const uint32_t steps = (now - lastTick_) / frameMs_;
  if (steps) {
    lastTick_ += steps * frameMs_;
    const uint32_t total = tick_ + steps;
    if (autoCycle_) {
      const uint8_t next = (static_cast<uint8_t>(expression_) +
                            total / ANIMATION_TICKS) % FACE_COUNT;
      if (next != static_cast<uint8_t>(expression_)) dirty_ = true;
      expression_ = static_cast<Expression>(next);
    }
    tick_ = total % ANIMATION_TICKS;
    const Pose nextPose = static_cast<Pose>(ANIMATION_POSES[tick_]);
    if (nextPose != pose_) dirty_ = true;
    pose_ = nextPose;
  }
  if (!dirty_) return false;
  display_.fillScreen(0);
  display_.drawBitmap(0, 0, FACE_BITMAPS[static_cast<uint8_t>(expression_)]
                     [static_cast<uint8_t>(pose_)], 128, 64, 1);
  dirty_ = false;
  return true;
}

#pragma once
#include <Arduino.h>
#include <Adafruit_GFX.h>

// Draws into an existing 128x64 GFX framebuffer. The caller initializes its
// hardware and flushes that framebuffer when update() returns true.
class ScoutFaces {
public:
  enum class Expression : uint8_t {
    Happy, Laughing, Surprised, Angry, Sad, Sleepy, Skeptical, Winking,
    Cheeky, Dizzy
  };
  enum class Pose : uint8_t {
    Center, LeftHalf, Left, RightHalf, Right, Up, Down, HalfClosed, Closed
  };
  explicit ScoutFaces(Adafruit_GFX& display);
  bool begin(uint32_t now = millis());
  bool update(uint32_t now = millis());
  // Select an expression and stop automatic expression cycling. Eye animation
  // continues. Call setAutoCycle(true) to resume cycling from that expression.
  void setExpression(Expression expression, uint32_t now = millis());
  void setAutoCycle(bool enabled, uint32_t now = millis());
  // 120 ms works with the tested 100 kHz SSD1306 bus. Minimum is 20 ms.
  void setFrameInterval(uint16_t milliseconds, uint32_t now = millis());
  Expression expression() const { return expression_; }
  Pose pose() const { return pose_; }
  bool autoCycle() const { return autoCycle_; }
  static const char* name(Expression expression);
  static constexpr uint8_t expressionCount() { return 10; }

private:
  void restart(uint32_t now);
  Adafruit_GFX& display_;
  uint32_t lastTick_ = 0;
  uint16_t frameMs_ = 120;
  uint8_t tick_ = 0;
  Expression expression_ = Expression::Happy;
  Pose pose_ = Pose::Center;
  bool autoCycle_ = true, ready_ = false, dirty_ = true;
};

}

param(
    [string]$SdkPath,
    [string]$JdkPath,
    [string]$GradlePath,
    [string]$HostTestScript
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$projectRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$androidRoot = Join-Path $projectRoot 'android'

function Find-Directory([string[]]$Candidates, [string]$Description) {
    foreach ($candidate in $Candidates) {
        if ($candidate -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidate -PathType Container)) {
            return (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $candidate).Path
        }
    }
    throw "$Description was not found. Supply its path using the corresponding script parameter."
}

$SdkPath = Find-Directory @($SdkPath, $env:ANDROID_HOME, $env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT,
    (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'tools\android-sdk'),
    (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Android\Sdk')) 'Android SDK'
if (-not $JdkPath) {
    $javaCommand = Get-Command java.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $javaHomeFromPath = if ($javaCommand) { Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $javaCommand.Source) }
    $JdkPath = Find-Directory @($env:JAVA_HOME, $javaHomeFromPath,
        (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'tools\jdk-21.0.12.1+1')) 'JDK'
} else {
    $JdkPath = Find-Directory @($JdkPath) 'JDK'
}
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $JdkPath 'bin\javac.exe'))) {
    throw "JDK must include bin\javac.exe: $JdkPath"
}
if (-not $GradlePath) {
    if ($env:GRADLE_HOME) { $GradlePath = Join-Path $env:GRADLE_HOME 'bin\gradle.bat' }
    elseif (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $androidRoot 'gradlew.bat')) {
        $GradlePath = Join-Path $androidRoot 'gradlew.bat'
    } else {
        $gradleCommand = Get-Command gradle.bat -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        if ($gradleCommand) { $GradlePath = $gradleCommand.Source }
        else { $GradlePath = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'tools\gradle-8.11.1\bin\gradle.bat' }
    }
}
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $GradlePath -PathType Container) { $GradlePath = Join-Path $GradlePath 'bin\gradle.bat' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $GradlePath -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Gradle not found: $GradlePath" }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $androidRoot 'settings.gradle')) -and
    -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $androidRoot 'settings.gradle.kts'))) {
    throw "Android project settings are missing from $androidRoot"
}

$oldJavaHome = $env:JAVA_HOME
$oldAndroidHome = $env:ANDROID_HOME
$oldSdkRoot = $env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT
$oldPath = $env:PATH
try {
    $env:JAVA_HOME = $JdkPath
    $env:ANDROID_HOME = $SdkPath
    $env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT = $SdkPath
    $env:PATH = "$(Join-Path $JdkPath 'bin');$oldPath"
    if (-not $HostTestScript) {
        foreach ($candidate in @('scripts\test-android.ps1', 'android\test-host.ps1', 'android\tests\run-tests.ps1')) {
            $testPath = Join-Path $projectRoot $candidate
            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $testPath -PathType Leaf) { $HostTestScript = $testPath; break }
        }
    }
    if ($HostTestScript) {
        $testPath = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $HostTestScript).Path
        $shellPath = (Get-Process -Id $PID).Path
        & $shellPath -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $testPath
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Android host tests failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }
    } else { Write-Warning 'No Android host test script was found.' }

    & $GradlePath -p $androidRoot --no-daemon assembleDebug
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Android build failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }
    $builtApk = Join-Path $androidRoot 'app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $builtApk)) { throw "Expected debug APK missing: $builtApk" }
    $signer = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $SdkPath 'build-tools') -Directory |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$' } |
        Sort-Object { [version]$_.Name } -Descending |
        ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_.FullName 'apksigner.bat' } |
        Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ } | Select-Object -First 1
    if (-not $signer) { throw 'Android SDK apksigner.bat was not found.' }
    & $signer verify --verbose --print-certs $builtApk
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'APK signature verification failed.' }
    $artifactDirectory = Join-Path $projectRoot 'artifacts'
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $artifactDirectory -Force | Out-Null
    $artifactApk = Join-Path $artifactDirectory 'Scout-Control-debug.apk'
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $builtApk -Destination $artifactApk -Force
    Write-Host "Verified APK: $artifactApk"
    Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $artifactApk -Algorithm SHA256
} finally {
    $env:JAVA_HOME = $oldJavaHome
    $env:ANDROID_HOME = $oldAndroidHome
    $env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT = $oldSdkRoot
    $env:PATH = $oldPath
}

"""Bundle the offline browser controller into a deterministic gzipped flash page."""
from pathlib import Path
import gzip
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
WEB = ROOT / 'firmware/web'
html = (WEB / 'index.html').read_text(encoding='utf8')
for marker, name in [('@@CORE@@','control-core.js'),('@@APP@@','control-app.js')]:
    html = html.replace(marker,(WEB / name).read_text(encoding='utf8'))
assert '@@' not in html
data = gzip.compress(html.encode('utf8'),compresslevel=9,mtime=0)
header = ['// Generated by scripts/build-web-control.py', '#pragma once', '#include <Arduino.h>',
          'const uint8_t WEB_CONTROL_PAGE[] PROGMEM = {']
header += ['  '+','.join(f'0x{b:02x}' for b in data[i:i+24])+',' for i in range(0,len(data),24)]
header += ['};']
(ROOT/'firmware/ScoutDrive/WebControlPage.h').write_text('\n'.join(header)+'\n')
out = ROOT/'artifacts/web-control';out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
(out/'index.html').write_text(html,encoding='utf8')
assert gzip.decompress(data).decode('utf8') == html
print(f'Browser page: {len(html.encode("utf8")):,} bytes; {len(data):,} bytes compressed in flash.')

param(
    [string]$Serial,
    [string]$ApkPath,
    [string]$AdbPath
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$projectRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
if (-not $ApkPath) { $ApkPath = Join-Path $projectRoot 'artifacts\Scout-Control-debug.apk' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ApkPath -PathType Leaf)) { throw "APK not found: $ApkPath. Run build-android.ps1 first." }
$ApkPath = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $ApkPath).Path
if (-not $AdbPath) {
    $adbCommand = Get-Command adb.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($adbCommand) { $AdbPath = $adbCommand.Source }
    else {
        foreach ($sdkPath in @($env:ANDROID_HOME, $env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT,
            (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'tools\android-sdk'),
            (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Android\Sdk'))) {
            if ($sdkPath) {
                $candidate = Join-Path $sdkPath 'platform-tools\adb.exe'
                if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidate -PathType Leaf) { $AdbPath = $candidate; break }
            }
        }
    }
}
if (-not $AdbPath -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $AdbPath -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'ADB was not found. Supply -AdbPath.' }
$deviceOutput = & $AdbPath devices -l
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'ADB could not list connected devices.' }
$devices = @($deviceOutput | ForEach-Object {
    if ($_ -match '^(\S+)\s+(device|unauthorized|offline)\b(.*)$') {
        [pscustomobject]@{ Serial = $Matches[1]; State = $Matches[2]; Details = $Matches[3] }
    }
})
$physicalDevices = @($devices | Where-Object {
    $_.State -eq 'device' -and $_.Serial -notmatch '^emulator-|:|\._tcp\.?$'
} | Where-Object {
    # Windows ADB may omit the usb: detail even for a physical USB connection.
    $emulatorFlag = & $AdbPath -s $_.Serial shell getprop ro.kernel.qemu
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Could not identify connected device '$($_.Serial)'." }
    ($emulatorFlag -join '').Trim() -ne '1'
})
if ($Serial) {
    $selected = @($physicalDevices | Where-Object { $_.Serial -eq $Serial })
    if ($selected.Count -ne 1) { throw "Device '$Serial' is not an authorized physical USB device. Check USB debugging and its authorization prompt." }
} else {
    if ($physicalDevices.Count -ne 1) {
        throw "Expected one authorized physical USB device; found $($physicalDevices.Count). Connect and authorize the phone, or select one with -Serial."
    }
    $selected = $physicalDevices
}
$deviceSerial = $selected[0].Serial
Write-Host "Installing Scout Control on $deviceSerial"
& $AdbPath -s $deviceSerial install -r $ApkPath
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'APK installation failed.' }
$launchOutput = & $AdbPath -s $deviceSerial shell am start -W -n 'com.scout.control/.MainActivity'
$launchExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
$launchOutput | Write-Host
if ($launchExitCode -ne 0 -or ($launchOutput -match 'Error:|Exception')) { throw 'Scout Control could not be launched.' }
Write-Host 'Scout Control installed and launched.'

  // Windows/Chromium may announce a final network-change event just after DHCP.
  for(let attempt=0;;attempt++){
    try { await page.goto('http://192.168.4.1/',{waitUntil:'domcontentloaded'});break; }
    catch(e){if(attempt>=2||!String(e).includes('ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED'))throw e;await page.waitForTimeout(500);}
  }
  await page.bringToFront();
  const status=()=>page.evaluate(async()=>await(await fetch('/status',{cache:'no-store'})).json());
  const initial=await status();assert.ok(initial.ready&&initial.oledReady&&initial.browserControl);
  assert.equal(initial.connected,false);
  await page.locator('#connect').click();
  await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.getElementById('state').textContent.includes('● Connected'));
  assert.equal(await page.locator('#saveDirections').isDisabled(),true);
  const rejected=await page.evaluate(async()=>({code:(await fetch('/session',{method:'POST',body:''})).status}));
  assert.equal(rejected.code,409);
  const pad=await page.locator('#pad').boundingBox();
  await page.mouse.move(pad.x+pad.width/2,pad.y+pad.height*.08);await page.mouse.down();
  await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.getElementById('left').textContent.includes('+44'));
  for(const id of [0,9,-1]){
    await page.locator(`#faces button[data-id="${id}"]`).evaluate(b=>b.click());
    await page.waitForFunction(id=>document.querySelector(`#faces button[data-id="${id}"]`).getAttribute('aria-pressed')==='true',id);
    const j=await status();assert.equal(j.face,id);assert.equal(j.left,44);assert.equal(j.right,44);assert.ok(j.oledReady&&j.connected);
  }
  const moving=await status();assert.ok(moving.enabled);
  await page.mouse.up();await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.getElementById('left').textContent==='L 0%');
  assert.ok((await status()).connected);
  await page.screenshot({path:path.join(out,'device-browser.png'),fullPage:true});
  await page.locator('#stop').click();await page.waitForTimeout(100);
  let j=await status();assert.ok(!j.connected&&!j.enabled&&j.left===0&&j.right===0);
  await page.locator('#directions summary').click();await page.locator('#saveDirections').click();
  await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.getElementById('configStatus').textContent==='Directions saved on Scout');
  j=await status();assert.equal(j.leftReversed,initial.leftReversed);assert.equal(j.rightReversed,initial.rightReversed);
  console.log('PASS served page: drive +44/+44, Happy/Dizzy/Auto while held, release, Stop, direction save, Android session exclusion');
  await page.evaluate(()=>{
    window.rawOpen=()=>new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
      const w=new WebSocket('ws://192.168.4.1:81/','arduino');
      const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('Raw socket open timed out')),1800);
      w.onopen=()=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve(w);};w.onerror=()=>reject(Error('Raw socket open failed'));
    });
    window.rawRequest=(w,data,key)=>new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
      const timer=setTimeout(()=>{w.removeEventListener('message',receive);reject(Error('Raw reply timed out'));},1800);
      function receive(event){const j=JSON.parse(event.data);if(key in j){clearTimeout(timer);w.removeEventListener('message',receive);resolve(j);}}
      w.addEventListener('message',receive);w.send(data);
    });
  });
  await page.evaluate(async()=>{
    window.oldSocket=await rawOpen();const claimed=await rawRequest(oldSocket,'C','token');
    await rawRequest(oldSocket,ScoutControl.encodeDrive(claimed.token,1,44,44),'ack');
  });
  await page.waitForTimeout(50);assert.equal((await status()).left,44);
  await page.waitForTimeout(1100);j=await status();assert.ok(!j.connected&&!j.enabled&&j.left===0&&j.oledReady);
  // Simulate the existing Android HTTP session, then disconnect the stale browser.
  const oldClose=await page.evaluate(async()=>{
    const r=await fetch('/session',{method:'POST',body:''});const s=await r.json();
    oldSocket.close();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60));
    const current=await(await fetch('/status',{cache:'no-store'})).json();
    await fetch('/stop',{method:'POST',body:''});
    return {code:r.status,created:s.connected,stillConnected:current.connected};
  });
  assert.equal(oldClose.code,200);assert.ok(oldClose.created&&oldClose.stillConnected);
  await page.evaluate(async()=>{
    window.ownerSocket=await rawOpen();const s=await rawRequest(ownerSocket,'C','token');
    let seq=0;window.ownerTick=setInterval(()=>{
      if(ownerSocket.readyState===WebSocket.OPEN&&!ownerSocket.bufferedAmount)
        ownerSocket.send(ScoutControl.encodeDrive(s.token,++seq,0,0));
    },50);
    const observer=await rawOpen();const denied=await rawRequest(observer,'C','error');
    if(!denied.error)throw Error('Observer unexpectedly claimed control');observer.close();
  });
  assert.ok((await status()).connected);
  await page.evaluate(()=>{clearInterval(ownerTick);ownerSocket.close();});
  await page.waitForTimeout(120);j=await status();assert.ok(!j.connected&&!j.enabled);
  await page.evaluate(async()=>{
    const bad=await rawOpen();await rawRequest(bad,'C','token');
    await rawRequest(bad,new Uint8Array([1,2,3]),'error');bad.close();
  });
  j=await status();assert.ok(!j.connected&&!j.enabled);
  const rejectedOrigin=await new Promise(resolve=>{
    let data='';const s=net.connect(81,'192.168.4.1');
    s.setTimeout(1500,()=>{s.destroy();resolve(!data.includes('101 Switching'));});
    s.on('connect',()=>s.write(`GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 192.168.4.1:81\r\nUpgrade: websocket\r\nConnection: Upgrade\r\nSec-WebSocket-Key: ${crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('base64')}\r\nSec-WebSocket-Version: 13\r\nOrigin: http://example.invalid\r\n\r\n`));
    s.on('data',b=>{data+=b.toString();if(data.includes('\r\n\r\n'))s.end();});
    s.on('close',()=>resolve(!data.includes('101 Switching')));s.on('error',()=>resolve(false));
  });
  assert.ok(rejectedOrigin);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out,'device-result.json'),JSON.stringify({
    testedAt:new Date().toISOString(),boot:initial.boot,drive:{left:moving.left,right:moving.right,oledReady:moving.oledReady},
    tested:['served compressed page','joystick','face changes while driving','release','Stop','direction save',
      'Android/browser exclusion','1000 ms browser lease expiry','stale owner disconnect','observer exclusion','disconnect stop','invalid frame stop','origin rejection'],
    final:await status()
  },null,2));
  console.log('PASS real WebSocket: lease expiry, stale owner, observer exclusion, disconnect, malformed frames, origin rejection; Scout stopped');
})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exitCode=1;}).finally(async()=>{clearTimeout(deadline);if(browser)await browser.close();});

const {chromium}=require('C:/Users/instr/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/node_modules/playwright');
const fs=require('node:fs'),http=require('node:http'),assert=require('node:assert/strict'),path=require('node:path');
const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..'),out=path.join(root,'artifacts/verification/web-control');
fs.mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true});
(async()=>{
  const html=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'artifacts/web-control/index.html'));
  const server=http.createServer((req,res)=>{res.setHeader('Content-Type','text/html');res.end(html);});
  await new Promise(r=>server.listen(8765,'127.0.0.1',r));
  let browser;
  try{
    browser=await chromium.launch({headless:true,channel:'chrome'});
    for(const [name,viewport] of [['portrait',{width:390,height:844}],['small-phone',{width:375,height:667}],['landscape',{width:844,height:390}]]){
      const page=await browser.newPage({viewport});
      let selected=-1,left=0,right=0,connected=false;
      const status=extra=>({protocol:2,version:'SCOUT 2',timeoutMs:400,browserTimeoutMs:1000,boot:7,ready:true,enabled:false,
        connected,left,right,face:selected,oledReady:true,leftReversed:true,rightReversed:true,...extra});
      await page.routeWebSocket('**',ws=>{
        ws.send(JSON.stringify(status()));
        ws.onMessage(data=>{
          if(typeof data==='string'){
            if(data==='C'){connected=true;ws.send(JSON.stringify(status({token:'0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef'})));}
            if(data==='S'){connected=false;left=right=0;ws.send(JSON.stringify(status()));}
            if(data.startsWith('F,')){selected=Number(data.slice(2));ws.send(JSON.stringify(status()));}
          }else{
            const b=Buffer.from(data);left=b.readInt16BE(41);right=b.readInt16BE(43);
            ws.send(JSON.stringify(status({ack:b.readUInt32BE(37)})));
          }
        });
        ws.onClose(()=>{connected=false;left=right=0;});
      });
      await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8765');await page.bringToFront();
      await page.locator('#connect').click();
      await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.getElementById('state').textContent.includes('● Connected'));
      assert.equal(await page.locator('#faces button').count(),11);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('#saveDirections').isDisabled(),true);
      const stop=await page.locator('#stop').boundingBox();assert.ok(stop.y>=0&&stop.y+stop.height<=viewport.height+1,name+' Stop visibility');
      const pad=await page.locator('#pad').boundingBox();
      const firstFace=await page.locator('#faces button').first().boundingBox();
      assert.ok(firstFace.y+firstFace.height<=stop.y-3,name+' face row must stay above Stop');
      assert.ok(pad.y+pad.height<=stop.y-3,name+' joystick must stay above Stop');
      await page.mouse.move(pad.x+pad.width/2,pad.y+pad.height*.08);await page.mouse.down();
      await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.getElementById('left').textContent.includes('+44'));
      await page.locator('#faces button').filter({hasText:'Happy'}).evaluate(b=>b.click());
      await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.getElementById('faceStatus').textContent==='Happy');
      await page.mouse.up();await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.getElementById('left').textContent==='L 0%');
      assert.equal(connected,true);
      await page.screenshot({path:path.join(out,`browser-${name}.png`),fullPage:true});
      await page.locator('#stop').click();
      assert.equal(await page.locator('#connect').isEnabled(),true);
      await page.close();
      console.log('PASS '+name+': connect, eleven face buttons, drive+face, release, visible Stop, calibration lock');
    }
  }finally{if(browser)await browser.close();await new Promise(r=>server.close(r));}
})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exitCode=1;});

// Actual Scout, RUN OPEN. Exercises settings/focus transitions and idle heartbeats.
const {chromium}=require('C:/Users/instr/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/node_modules/playwright');
const assert=require('node:assert/strict'),fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path');
let browser,page;const started=Date.now(),events=[];
const deadline=setTimeout(()=>{console.error('Settings bench exceeded 110 seconds');process.exit(2);},110000);
(async()=>{
 browser=await chromium.launch({headless:true,channel:'chrome',args:['--no-proxy-server']});
 page=await browser.newPage({viewport:{width:390,height:844}});page.setDefaultTimeout(4000);
 page.on('websocket',ws=>ws.on('close',()=>events.push({type:'socket-close',at:Date.now()-started})));
 await page.goto('http://192.168.4.1/',{waitUntil:'domcontentloaded'});await page.bringToFront();
 const status=()=>page.evaluate(async()=>await(await fetch('/status',{cache:'no-store'})).json());
 const initial=await status();assert.ok(initial.ready&&initial.oledReady&&!initial.connected);
 // Confirm this is the newly served fix, rather than an old cached page.
 assert.ok((await page.content()).includes("Queue its immediate zero through send()'s bounded backlog check"));
 await page.locator('#connect').click();
 await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.getElementById('state').textContent.includes('● Connected'));
 for(let i=0;i<30;i++){
  const pad=page.locator('#pad');await pad.focus();await page.keyboard.down('ArrowUp');
  await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.getElementById('left').textContent.includes('+'));
  if(i%2){
   await page.locator('#limit').evaluate((b,n)=>{b.value=String(n);b.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));},35+(i%4)*15);
  }else{
   await page.locator(`#faces button[data-id="${i%11-1}"]`).evaluate(b=>{b.focus();b.click();});
  }
  await page.keyboard.up('ArrowUp');
  await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.getElementById('left').textContent==='L 0%');
  const j=await status();assert.equal(j.boot,initial.boot,'Scout restarted');assert.ok(j.connected&&j.oledReady,'Session/OLED ended during settings change');
 }
 console.log('PASS 30 drive-to-settings transitions without reconnect or restart');
 for(let i=0;i<35;i++){
  await page.locator(`#faces button[data-id="${i%11-1}"]`).evaluate(b=>b.click());
  await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
  const j=await status();assert.equal(j.boot,initial.boot);assert.ok(j.connected&&j.oledReady);
 }
 await page.locator('#faces button[data-id="-1"]').evaluate(b=>b.click());
 await page.locator('#stop').click();await page.waitForTimeout(100);
 const final=await status();assert.ok(!final.connected&&!final.enabled&&final.left===0&&final.right===0);
 const result={passed:true,elapsedMs:Date.now()-started,boot:initial.boot,settingsTransitions:30,idleFaceChanges:35,unexpectedSocketCloses:events.length,final};
 const out=path.resolve(__dirname,'../artifacts/verification/web-settings-fix');fs.mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true});
 fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out,'device-result.json'),JSON.stringify(result,null,2));
 console.log('PASS idle/settings soak, unchanged boot, OLED ready, final stopped');
})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exitCode=1;}).finally(async()=>{
 clearTimeout(deadline);
 if(page)try{await page.evaluate(()=>fetch('/stop',{method:'POST',signal:AbortSignal.timeout(1200)}));}catch(_){}
 if(browser)await browser.close();
});

param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][ValidatePattern('^COM[0-9]+$')][string]$Port,
    [switch]$RunOpenAndEspUsbConnected,
    [string]$ArduinoCli = 'C:\Program Files\Arduino IDE\resources\app\lib\backend\resources\arduino-cli.exe'
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
if (-not $RunOpenAndEspUsbConnected) {
    throw 'Confirm the physical setup first: carrier RUN is OPEN and ESP USB is connected. Then provide -RunOpenAndEspUsbConnected. Unplug ESP USB before RUN ON.'
}
$project = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
$config = Join-Path $project 'firmware\build\arduino-cli.yaml'
$output = Join-Path $project 'firmware\output'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $output 'ScoutDrive.ino.bin'))) { throw 'Compile firmware first using scripts/build-firmware.ps1.' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $config)) { throw 'Run scripts/build-firmware.ps1 once to configure the installed toolchain.' }
& $ArduinoCli upload --config-file $config --fqbn 'esp32:esp32:esp32c3:CDCOnBoot=cdc' --port $Port --input-dir $output (Join-Path $project 'firmware\ScoutDrive')
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Firmware upload failed ($LASTEXITCODE)" }
